Friends, **Today is a dark day in America's history — the Supreme Court just overturned _Roe v. Wade_ , setting in motion national consequences.** Supreme Court justices voted 6-3 in _Dobbs v. Jackson Women's Health Organization_ to ban abortion procedures in almost all cases in Mississippi. Nearly 50 years after the landmark Roe decision established the constitutional right to legal, safe abortion in 1973, SCOTUS is taking away a constitutional right for the first time in U.S. history. Now, one of the most important decisions a person can make about their body and future will be determined by the state they live in. After decades of right-wing attacks on reproductive healthcare, this reckless decision is a devastating blow to our movement for reproductive justice. Millions of people will be forced to go to dangerous lengths to get a once-safe procedure, which will in turn cost lives. **To all the women, parents, activists, and families who fought for safe and legal abortions two generations ago, just to see them lost now — I am sorry.** I am sorry that the leadership of our country — the country I was willing to fight and die for — has failed you. I’m a combat veteran. I flew Apache helicopters over Baghdad and Fallujah. I was always ready to fight for my country, and nothing has changed. I will not stand to be made a second-class citizen in the country I put my life on the line to defend. In Pennsylvania, we can bet Republicans will waste no time banning abortion across the state. We have an extreme GOP gubernatorial candidate who promises to ban abortion in Pennsylvania if elected. **But we will not give up without a fight.** While a group of six unelected justices may disagree, a majority of Pennsylvanians support upholding Roe v. Wade. **Together, we have a movement behind us. We have history on our side. We hold more power as Americans when we organize, fight, mobilize, vote, and use our collective voices to speak truth to power.** We’re putting every anti-choice politician on notice. For years, Rep. Brian Fitzpatrick has supported the extreme effort to regulate our bodies without any consequences. As your next representative, I will always fight for our fundamental freedoms, bodily autonomy, and privacy because everyone deserves the opportunity to choose their own destiny. I will stand up for every Pennsylvanian to make their own healthcare decisions because I give a damn about _you_. Now is the time for us to use the fire lit within us to take action, and set a new path for the next generation so they live in a better, more inclusive world. **I fought for my country because I wanted to provide a better future for myself, and I’m committed to doing the same for women, LGBTQ+ folks, parents, working families, and our most vulnerable communities here in PA-01.** Until we truly live in a country that represents ALL of us, the fight for reproductive freedom must go on. clean_body: Here's what we do now. Friend, the Supreme Court just issued the ruling we've dreaded for decades. They've overturned Roe v. Wade , eliminating protections for abortion and empowering the GOP's full-frontal assault on access to safe reproductive health care. Even though we knew this was coming and Illinois didn't wait around to act, today is a painful day. But we can't let this fury we feel lead us to lose focus. The right to choose is on the ballot now. And every one of my Republican opponents for governor say they will restrict abortion if elected. That's why I'm fighting like hell to help elect pro-choice Democrats and why I'm asking you to stand with me. | I want every person reading this to understand clearly what today's outcome means for them. To the women of Illinois: You still have the right to abortion under state law, and as long as I am your governor, I will protect your bodily autonomy. To the women across America: Here in Illinois, we trust women. If your leaders abandon you, know that our state will be your safe haven. The Court is leading us down a dark path, and they won't stop at abortion. The twisted reasoning behind today's decision puts so many rights at risk, from access to birth control to protections for same-sex marriage. It's up to us, together, to re-route our course, starting by defeating the GOP's plot to ban abortion state by state. Will you volunteer with us to protect the right to choose and all the progress we've made for women and working families in Illinois? We're in the thick of the fight now and I'm grateful to stand alongside you, JB Paid for by JB for Governor Email sent to: dpwillis67@gmail.com * JB for Governor P.O. Dear Friends, Roe v. Wade has been established law for nearly 50 years, and we’ve been lied to by Supreme Court nominees who promised they would not disrupt the law of the land. Republicans in Congress have been working towards this day for decades. I’m angry, and I’m sure you are too. Reproductive rights are essential freedoms, and the Supreme Court’s decision to overturn _Roe_ v. _Wade_ underscores the need for immediate bold action. **I know today is an incredibly challenging day, especially for millions of women across our community and our country. Here’s my message to you: I’m more committed than ever to fight with you in the face of this horrible decision. ** I am certain that Florida Republicans will outright ban all abortion as soon as they’re able. subject: Breaking news: Roe v. Wade

body:
This outcome is devastating and I’m angry.

Team,
Breaking news: **The Supreme Court just overturned _Roe v. Wade_ , paving the way for Republicans across the country to pass new restrictions on reproductive freedom. **
I won’t mince words: This outcome is devastating and I’m angry. Politicians do not belong in our personal medical decisions, and Ohioans – and everyone in our country – deserve the opportunity to make the decisions that are best for them without interference from our statehouses.

**Peter, as of moments ago, millions of people throughout the country have lost their right to access abortion care.**
Though this decision was anticipated, it is no less devastating. Now, millions of people will be forced to carry pregnancies that are too costly, dangerous, or poorly timed to term. And Black, brown, and poor communities will be the most harmed by this decision.

But while the overturning of Roe is a major setback in our fight for reproductive freedom, it doesn’t mark the end of our struggle. I’m ready to roll up my sleeves and get back to work – because I’m confident that together, we will secure the right to choose for every last person in America.

So, Peter, if you’re feeling overwhelmed, powerless, furious, or a combination of all three, take some time away from the news today. Feel what you need to feel for as long as you need to, and remember to take care of yourself.

And then, when you’re ready to pick up the fight for reproductive rights once again, I’ll be here to lead the charge. subject: We’ve got to fight back with all we’ve got
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Donna Edwards 4 Congress
body:
It happened. Today, the Supreme Court struck down Roe v. Wade and stripped away the rights and autonomy of half the U.S. population. I’m scared for our most vulnerable, for the women who will die
It happened, Peter.
**Today, the Supreme Court struck down Roe v. Wade and stripped away the rights and autonomy of half the U.S. population.**
_I’m scared_ for our most vulnerable, for the women who will die from this decision and the countless others whose lives will be forever changed.
_I’m fearful_ for the Black and Brown women and poor women who’ll bear the brunt of this tragedy — facing terrible decisions when they can’t miss work or travel to states where abortion is still legal.
_I’m saddened_ by the rollback of 50 years of established rights, increased economic opportunity and self-determination for millions of women across our country.
**But most of all,_I’m angry._**

I am absolutely devastated and outraged by the court’s ruling to overturn Roe v. Wade, which will decimate access to abortion — especially for low-income women and women of color — across the country. **This ruling makes clear as day that it is not enough to just be pro-choice anymore.** I’ve dedicated my life to fighting tirelessly for women’s reproductive rights — from my time as Board President of Planned Parenthood Maryland to my current role as Executive Director of The Maryland Women’s Law Center. That fight will not end in a King-Siri administration and John and I pledge to make Maryland a North Star for the nation for safe and legal abortion care. Though Maryland lawmakers had the foresight to codify Roe in 1992, with this latest ruling it’s absolutely dire that we pass an amendment enshrining the right to an abortion in Maryland’s constitution. [_**If you believe that every woman has the right to make decisions about her own body, will you stand with John and I by adding your name to our petition to enshrine abortion rights in Maryland’s state constitution?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46907686/352281944/-56598711?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE0NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZDQ4M2M4ZS1jYWYzLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=tbWGbTEwoe_j1GENfCVxXC0Gm0khNEgSl3bG2vVFlZI=&emci=bceb5a3c-11e8-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=6d483c8e-caf3-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=24635484) | | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46907687/352281945/-1485588253?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE0NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZDQ4M2M4ZS1jYWYzLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=tbWGbTEwoe_j1GENfCVxXC0Gm0khNEgSl3bG2vVFlZI=&emci=bceb5a3c-11e8-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=6d483c8e-caf3-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=24635484)

With this horrendous ruling from SCOTUS and the federal government failing to take action to protect our bodily autonomy, it’s never been more important to elect reproductive champions to statewide office.**That’s why I am so proud our campaign was recently endorsed by Pro-Choice Maryland Action, the state’s leading reproductive rights group.** Our administration will stop at nothing to keep bans off women’s bodies because John and I believe wholeheartedly that abortion is health care, and health care is a human right.
This decision not only guts abortion rights, but is a direct attempt to severely restrict access to contraception, IVF (in-vitro fertilization) treatments, and reproductive health care. My two beautiful children were both born with the help of IVF, and now it will be that much harder for thousands of women seeking IVF treatments to start families of their own. **Every woman deserves ownership over her own fertility, family, and body. clean_body: If you believe that every woman has the right to make decisions about her own body, please sign our petition to enshrine abortion rights in Maryland’s state constitution. = | Peter, I wanted to share my thoughts about the recent news out of the Supreme Court. I am absolutely devastated and outraged by the court’s ruling to overturn Roe v. Wade, which will decimate access to abortion — especially for low-income women and women of color — across the country. This ruling makes clear as day that it is not enough to just be pro-choice anymore. I’ve dedicated my life to fighting tirelessly for women’s reproductive rights — from my time as Board President of Planned Parenthood Maryland to my current role as Executive Director of The Maryland Women’s Law Center. That fight will not end in a King-Siri administration and John and I pledge to make Maryland a North Star for the nation for safe and legal abortion care. Though Maryland lawmakers had the foresight to codify Roe in 1992, with this latest ruling it’s absolutely dire that we pass an amendment enshrining the right to an abortion in Maryland’s constitution. | | With this horrendous ruling from SCOTUS and the federal government failing to take action to protect our bodily autonomy, it’s never been more important to elect reproductive champions to statewide office.That’s why I am so proud our campaign was recently endorsed by Pro-Choice Maryland Action, the state’s leading reproductive rights group. Our administration will stop at nothing to keep bans off women’s bodies because John and I believe wholeheartedly that abortion is health care, and health care is a human right. This decision not only guts abortion rights, but is a direct attempt to severely restrict access to contraception, IVF (in-vitro fertilization) treatments, and reproductive health care. My two beautiful children were both born with the help of IVF, and now it will be that much harder for thousands of women seeking IVF treatments to start families of their own. Every woman deserves ownership over her own fertility, family, and body. Full stop. | We’re all in this fight together, Peter, and as Maryland’s next Lieutenant Governor, I’ll always be in your corner. Onwards and upwards, Michelle Siri P.S. body:
Peter,
Today, the Supreme Court officially overturned Roe v. Wade , taking away federal protections of abortion rights.
Now, the decision of whether women are “allowed” to seek abortion care will fall to the states.
And I want to be clear here — even after DeSantis’ 15-week abortion ban goes into effect, abortion is still legal in Florida before the 15 week mark. Our state doesn’t have trigger laws that immediately ban abortion now that Roe has been overturned.
That being said, with DeSantis determined to strip away as many of our freedoms as he can, there’s no telling how long that will last. Now that Roe has been overturned, he could call a special session to ban abortion entirely in a matter of weeks.
We need to fight with everything we have to keep that from happening, Peter.
So right now, I’m not asking for donations to my campaign. I’m asking you to donate to Planned Parenthood, donate to NARAL — or to any of the other countless local organizations that will be working around the clock, and against steep odds, to keep women safe in the aftermath of this decision.
I’m not going to pretend that this is going to be easy, or that this isn’t one of the worst attacks on women in modern political history. I’m not going to pretend that things will be ok, because we all know what this decision means for women’s health and safety.
But I will say this — for centuries, women have fought like hell to secure the rights we have today. And there’s no way we’re going to let our daughters, our granddaughters, and future generations of women have fewer rights than we did.
We’re going to stand together. We’re going to fight. And we’re going to win.
With thanks,
Nikki

#
Peter,
It’s official: the Supreme Court just overturned _Roe v. Wade_. I want to be very clear right now about where I stand in the fight for a woman’s right to make her own health care decisions.
I have always strongly believed that decisions about pregnancy and parenting should be between a woman and her doctor – and no one else. I have stood up to defend this right since I was first elected. _The Washington Post_ recently referred to me as “**the single most effective Democratic combatant against Republican attempts to restrict abortion** ” – and that’s a distinction I’ll gladly keep fighting to live up to.

**[Peter, as long as I’m in the U.S. Senate, I promise to be at the forefront of the fight for abortion rights. But I’m up for reelection this fall and I need your support. Will you chip in $5 right now to help me protect abortion access?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46907957/352283136/-789155985?refcode=pm_em_220624_1&&amount=5&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=18326&firstname=Peter&lastname=&addr1=&city=Cresco&state=PA&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzYmM2ZTllZi1jYWYzLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AaJh1m79Pod0KRoPSEaW4GWyMFjaeSszas6UuuJd4fU=)**
For the first time in a generation, _Roe v. Wade_ is not the law of the land and it will soon be illegal in states across the country for women to make their own decisions about their bodies and their futures.
Now more than ever, we need to elect a pro-choice Senate majority who will stand up to the extreme Republicans and Supreme Court justices who are inserting themselves into private medical decisions.
**[I can and will keep up this fight. Please, contribute whatever you can to support my reelection campaign.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46907958/352283138/-789155985?refcode=pm_em_220624_1&amount=5&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=18326&firstname=Peter&lastname=&addr1=&city=Cresco&state=PA&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzYmM2ZTllZi1jYWYzLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AaJh1m79Pod0KRoPSEaW4GWyMFjaeSszas6UuuJd4fU=)**

clean_body: This is a make-or-break moment for abortion rights. Peter, It’s official: the Supreme Court just overturned Roe v. Wade. I want to be very clear right now about where I stand in the fight for a woman’s right to make her own health care decisions. I have always strongly believed that decisions about pregnancy and parenting should be between a woman and her doctor – and no one else. I have stood up to defend this right since I was first elected. The Washington Post recently referred to me as “the single most effective Democratic combatant against Republican attempts to restrict abortion ” – and that’s a distinction I’ll gladly keep fighting to live up to. = For the first time in a generation, Roe v. Wade is not the law of the land and it will soon be illegal in states across the country for women to make their own decisions about their bodies and their futures. Now more than ever, we need to elect a pro-choice Senate majority who will stand up to the extreme Republicans and Supreme Court justices who are inserting themselves into private medical decisions. = Thank you for joining me in this fight. Patty Murray **= As Washington's senior U.S. Senator, Patty Murray is working to help families, solve problems, and defend our progressive values._ PAID FOR BY PEOPLE FOR PATTY MURRAY

Peter -
Today the Supreme Court confirmed what we feared was coming: a decision that ends every woman’s constitutional right to choose. With this one decision, the court is erasing 50 years of protecting that fundamental right.
This decision will drive state-by-state action on laws governing reproductive health. The result will be disastrous, for women and their families.Those who will suffer the most will be those who have the least. Our reproductive rights will be determined by geography – where we live – and not constitutional protection.
The government has no business controlling women's health care decisions.
It is now up to the Congress to protect women's reproductive health. I will fight in Congress to protect the rights of every woman in every state. I will work tirelessly to make sure everyone has access to affordable health care, including safe abortion.
I’m ready to go to Congress and fight for our freedom to choose. Donate to my campaign today to help me get there. [https://joyfoxcongress.com/donate-to-joy-fox-for-congress/]
It’s time for a woman to represent Rhode Island women and speak for our women and girls.
Thank you for your support,
Joy Fox

| Peter, this is it. The day we’ve been dreading since the leaked decision is here. The Supreme Court has unraveled decades of precedent and overturned _Roe v. Wade._

**Peter, I want to make something crystal clear: this is not a trivial matter.** This is a truly devastating decision. Across the country, thousands of folks have lost access to life-saving abortion care and, with it, their right to bodily autonomy.

We won’t let the GOP intimidate us into silence. And we won’t go back. We’ll never go back. That is why I proudly co-sponsored legislation in the State Senate two weeks ago to codify _Roe_ into law here in North Carolina. But, I know this is only one step. **We must codify _Roe_ on the federal level and protect reproductive rights once and for all.**

People’s lives truly are on the line with this decision. Please be assured, Peter: **I am wholly committed to defending and expanding reproductive rights.** I’ve proven it time and again in the State Senate and pledge to be a solid vote in Congress to codify _Roe v. Wade_ into law.

With care,

Valerie

| | Derek, The Supreme Court just overturned the constitutional right to abortion. We saw this decision coming after the draft majority opinion leaked last month, but that doesn’t make it any easier to stomach. Because of the ruling, states will now be able to make abortion illegal. I know a lot of people are wondering what we can do. One important task is to continue our work to put more pro-choice leaders into office. Here in Virginia, I am working hard to support the campaigns of candidates who will protect abortion access in the Commonwealth. My campaign is also supporting candidates nationwide who support the Women’s Health Protection Act. This federal bill would codify into federal law the right to an abortion, and would nullify the Supreme Court’s attack on women’s reproductive rights. But the only way it will pass is if we expand our majorities in both the House and the Senate. [_**We do not have time for despair. We must stand stronger than ever before in defense of reproductive rights. Will you add your name now if you are still with us in this fight?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46908534/352285458/820077879?ms=mw_em_220624_1&refcode=mw_em_220624_1&amount=5&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=Manassas&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNjc4ZWVlMC1jYmYzLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=aifNQ413IjBe1k4qVBnH8Fg74aWNlcNELtWuYPcDgqY=&emci=a83c0c2f-3af2-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=a678eee0-cbf3-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=4568237) I promised when the draft opinion leaked that I would do everything in my power to protect access to abortion. name: Derek Kilmer
subject: The Supreme Court has overturned Roe v. Wade.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by People for Derek Kilmer
body:
The majority of Americans support the right to choose.
Peter, my heart is heavy:

The Supreme Court has officially released its final decision to repeal over 50 years of protection for a person's right to privacy, choice, and reproductive freedom.

When _Politico_ first leaked the Supreme Court's draft decision to overturn _Roe v. Wade_ , millions of Americans were rightfully sent into a panic about what the future may hold for their health and even their lives.

Here's the hard truth: History has shown us that abortion will persist - _whether it 's legal or not_. Overruling _Roe_ won't end abortion. It will only end safe and legal abortion in over half of the states in our country.

Women of color, rural communities, people living paycheck to paycheck, and other marginalized people will bear the brunt of the repercussions. People will be left with no choice but to travel hundreds of miles to the nearest clinic, struggle with long wait times, and deal with financial barriers. This is the reality of a future without _Roe v. Wade_.

Peter, if you're feeling disheartened about the state of things, I don't blame you. But on our team, we say this: "Don't agonize. Organize!" **I want to take this opportunity to tell you that I will never stop fighting against these unjustified attacks on reproductive freedom.** Congress has the power to pass legislation to protect the right to choose. I have sponsored legislation to do just that and am pushing to make it law.

The election this November couldn't be more crucial. We need to continue fighting to elect pro-choice Democratic leaders who will fight for ALL Americans.

As always, it's an honor to represent you,

Derek Kilmer

Peter,

Since this campaign began, I've spoken with people across Oklahoma -- and across the political spectrum -- about the challenges they're facing, and how a governor can help make their lives better. In recent months, more and more people have come up to me to share their profound worries about a Supreme Court decision overturning Roe v. Wade.

That decision is now here, and it has many implications. My most immediate concern is what it means for Oklahoma women, their families, and their healthcare providers.

I have been clear about my position on abortion: I am personally pro-life. But I believe this decision is about healthcare and should be made between a woman and her doctor -- and it needs to stay that way.

I don't support extremism on this issue from either side. Unfortunately, extremism is what Governor Stitt has decided we should live under in Oklahoma.

Stitt has aligned himself with people who don't care about protecting the lives of mothers. He is standing with ideologues who make no exceptions for terrible scenarios many women will face. And he is siding with bounty hunters who can exploit vulnerable women and doctors to make money.

The court has said that abortion access should be decided at the state level. **My decision is to work as hard as I can to ensure Oklahoma has reasonable, responsible leadership who protects women, families, and doctors.**

We can't allow the extremist fringes, on this and so many other issues, to overwhelm the Oklahoma values that so many of us hold dear. I hope you'll stand with me and our growing coalition as we work hard to restore reason, problem solving, and compassion to our state.

On a difficult day for so many, it's energizing to know how many people across the state are willing to step up for a better future.

Thank you,

Joy [DONATE ONCE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46910107/352291528/1763363830?refcode=em22_220624_Roe&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzUwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyOWFlYWRlNS1jZGYzLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4qJa-SRI-afnengR0JjX0f2eIi-0HiAS3bAMQ1jFLFI=) [DONATE MONTHLY](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46910108/352291537/1763363830?refcode=em22_220624_Roe&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzUwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyOWFlYWRlNS1jZGYzLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4qJa-SRI-afnengR0JjX0f2eIi-0HiAS3bAMQ1jFLFI=)

You’ve probably heard the bad news: the Supreme Court has just thrown out a half-century of precedent and overturned Roe v. Wade.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46910260/352292079/-1015964469?refcode=BLU-JRFC-20220624-1-EM&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZWM1NTkwYi1jZWYzLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=x00ES9F8116lCH8CyRaeSwfDlCBxIwkZXPoAZAl-7TI=)
---
| Peter,

You’ve probably heard the bad news: the Supreme Court has just thrown out a half-century of precedent and overturned _Roe v. Wade._

**Let’s be clear:** this decision endangers lives, tramples the human right to bodily autonomy, and is completely out of touch with how the majority of Americans feel about abortion.

Millions of Americans across the country have just lost their right to make their own choices about their reproductive health, including when or whether they want to start a family.

This is why, now more than ever, we must come together to protect reproductive health care and freedom, including access to abortion, at the federal level.

Peter, this is a sad day, but know this: I am wholly committed to restoring and defending reproductive rights.

**In Congress, I pledge to support legislation to codify _Roe v. Wade_ into law.**

The right to control one’s own body is foundational to liberty, and I pledge to always take a stand and defend that right against anyone seeking to take it away.

Peter, we cannot and will not ever go back.

Take care,

Josh Riley

body:
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/81826/images/FAWlogo_Blue%404x.png]
Dear Peter,
This is a dark day for America. The Supreme Court has just ruled to overturn Roe v. Wade in a stunning reversal of decades of legal precedent. Abortion is now outlawed in at least 26 states, and the right to choose has been taken away for millions of women across the country.
Like many of you, I am outraged by this decision. This is an attack on women, and it will disproportionately affect our minority communities and those who are economically disadvantaged.
It is now more urgent than ever that we protect and expand access to abortion care at the state level. As Governor, I’ll fight to enshrine the right to an abortion into the state constitution, ensure that healthcare providers cover abortion services, and ensure that undocumented Marylanders have access to safe, full care. Abortion is healthcare, and everyone deserves the right to choose.

And earlier this year, I urged the Governor to immediately release $3.5 million restricted in the Fiscal Year 2023 operating budget to provide funding for abortion care training programs. I repeat the same call today.
Abortion is now outlawed in nearby states like West Virginia, Ohio, Tennessee, and Kentucky. I firmly believe that our state should be prepared to step up and provide these critical healthcare services to women who need them.
We cannot let the anti-abortion extremists take us further backwards. Let this day be a call to action. We must make our voices heard at the ballot box. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/roevwade_franchot?amount=20.22]

body:

The Supreme Court has made its decision final and overturned 50 years of precedent established by _Roe v. Wade._

Please join us in solidarity with progress and a brighter future for all Americans.

Please join us in asserting that moving our society backward is not the way forward.**_

name: Lizzie Pannill Fletcher
subject: The Supreme Court’s decision
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe2206scotus?refcode=lpfe2206scotus_a [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe2206scotus?refcode=lpfe2206scotus_a]
The Supreme Court has done it — something we have feared could happen for years, and feared more acutely over the last few months. The court has overturned Roe v. Wade and more than 50 years of precedent that has protected the health, dignity, privacy, and autonomy of Americans.
Many thought this day would never come, but we have been warned that it could happen for as long as I can remember. And that is because this decision comes from a long-term, focused strategy to overturn Roe v. Wade .
That strategy has included passing laws in the states to chip away at Roe ’s protections incrementally. That strategy resulted in laws like we have in Texas — placing onerous restrictions on women seeking abortions, including invasive ultrasounds, 24-hour waiting periods, and state-mandated misinformation and on abortion providers, singling them out for unequal treatment among health care providers. That strategy worked. While abortion got harder and harder to get, many people still felt that Roe would protect this fundamental right.
But in Texas, we know that is not the case. Last year, the Texas legislature enacted one of the most restrictive abortion laws in the country. It outlawed abortion after about six weeks and it deputized vigilantes to sue anyone helping someone seeking an abortion. Even with these unprecedented and unconstitutional provisions, the Supreme Court refused to rule on an emergency petition to review the law before it went into effect. As a result, abortion is effectively banned in Texas. As it now is in Oklahoma. As it will be in many other states. And as it will be across the country if Republican leaders in Congress have their way, and regain the majority. Some have already said they would propose a nationwide abortion ban in the next Congress.
I’m not giving up though. Frankly, it’s not an option. We need to have a sustained strategy, focus, and commitment to protect our rights and freedoms. There are many things we must do. But we know we can’t rely solely on courts to protect our autonomy, dignity, and privacy. We know we need to elect leaders who will. And that’s what this team will do.
In 2018, we won this seat together, sending me to Congress with a historic number of women from across the country. We flipped the House on the strength of those victories. And we changed the face of the Congress. Last fall, our pro-choice majority in the House passed the Women’s Health Protection Act to codify Roe in all 50 states.
That is what’s possible when we work together to elect leaders who share our values and who fight for them in office.
There’s no doubt we have our work cut out for us. There are important elections this year in Texas and across the country, including ours in TX-07. It’s going to take all of us participating to change the path the Supreme Court put us on today.
Thank you for all you do.
Together, we can do anything,
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie_signature-1.png]

In 2018, we won this seat together, sending me to Congress with a historic number of women from across the country. We flipped the House on the strength of those victories. And we changed the face of the Congress. Last fall, our pro-choice majority in the House passed the Women’s Health Protection Act to codify Roe in all 50 states. That is what’s possible when we work together to elect leaders who share our values and who fight for them in office. There’s no doubt we have our work cut out for us. There are important elections this year in Texas and across the country, including ours in TX-07. It’s going to take all of us participating to change the path the Supreme Court put us on today. For those five decades, the _Roe v. Wade_ decision provided pregnant women the privacy and solemnity to make their own health care decisions. In an instant, the Court struck it down and thus set off what will be a deluge of state legislative actions to further curtail family planning decisions for women, often in crisis.

| | I am an advocate of **life** and a proponent of **choice** , **privacy** , and **individual liberty**. I support proven measures to **reduce** abortion.**** **Advocating for life means:**
* Supporting children before and after birth
* Programs that assist working parents
* Increasing access to affordable education from Pre-3 on
* Affordable and accessible childcare
* Addressing childhood poverty
* Improving and promoting adoption services and foster programs
* Universal healthcare

**Protecting choice means:**
* Upholding Roe V. Wade
* Supporting reproductive services
* Family planning/contraception
* Providing access to safe and legal abortion
* Protecting a woman's right to privacy
* Proper sex education based on consent

Roe v. Wade, a decision protecting a woman's fundamental right to privacy, was the law of the land. As Ruth Bader Ginsburg stated, it is "a woman's right to control her own destiny, to be able to make choices without a Big Brother state telling her what she can and cannot do." Very often, religious beliefs are the foundation of anti-abortion views, and my or your religious beliefs should not be the basis for the laws of our country. As a physician, I can confidently say no one anticipates or wants to be in a position to decide to have an abortion. It can be a harrowing decision for everyone involved. **I can personally advocate for life and politically be pro-choice. These two positions are not mutually exclusive.** In the end, the government should not serve as the decider on a woman's medical decisions or religious beliefs. If the goal is abortion prevention, making it illegal is ineffective. It only makes it more dangerous. Comprehensive sex education and affordable and accessible birth control are proven to work.

TIM BAXTER RESPONDS TO THE SUPREME COURT'S DECISION OVERTURNING ROE V. WADE **New Hampshire (June 24, 2022)** \- Upon the Supreme Court's decision to strike down their 1973 ruling in Roe v. Wade, state representative and candidate for Congress Tim Baxter releases the following statement: _"Today is a historical day for our country. For nearly five decades, the unethical practice of abortion enjoyed Constitutional protections at the federal level. Following the Supreme Court's decision, the issue will now be returned to the states to decide. _ _We are experiencing history in the making, and our conservative values are winning all across the country. Millions of unborn lives will now be saved in red states thanks to President Donald J. Trump's appointments and the Supreme Court's courageous decision. _ _There is still work to be done. We need proven conservative leaders in Congress who will stand up against the radical abortionists' attempts to codify abortion into federal law, and I look forward to defending the lives of the unborn once I'm elected to Congress."_ _###_ All media inquiries should be submitted to:

Peter,

**The Supreme Court just overturned Roe v. Wade.**
I'm heartbroken by this news, Peter. As a healthcare worker, I believe everyone deserves access to the very best medical care. As a citizen, I will keep marching and advocating. **And as your next senator, I will work relentlessly for my constituents to be able to make their decisions with their doctors.**
This decision means that the right to choose is now up to each state, and in Missouri, there will be no exceptions for abortion – even in cases of rape or incest.
**We need to protect the legal right to abortion, full stop. **
That's why in this urgent moment, I'm supporting Pro-Choice Missouri, because everyone who needs access to reproductive healthcare, including abortion, should be able to get it.
We need to support organizations on the front lines that will help people get abortions when they choose.** [Peter, will you rush a donation to Pro-Choice Missouri? body:
# [#]While we knew this was coming, it does not make it sting any less. The Supreme Court has overturned Roe v. Wade .

This ruling is a horrendous attack on a woman's right to choose. This is a crisis, and we must act now to protect women’s health care.

In 2016, I ran for Congress against an anti-choice extremist with the promise that I would fight to defend the right to choose. As your Congressman, I have fought to ensure that every individual can make their own decisions about their health, and I won’t stop now.

We cannot sit idly by and watch as millions of people’s rights get ripped away.

I voted to codify Roe v. Wade into law, and it’s time for the Senate to do the same. I will not stop fighting until we guarantee a woman’s right to choose.

— Josh

body:
Hello friends of Kathy Salvi,

This is Valeria from the Salvi team. I am emailing all of you to ask for a special effort in these last few days to promote Kathy Salvi for US Senate!

Valeria

name: Kirsten Gillibrand
subject: Roe v. Wade:
body:
[https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif] Friend, the Supreme Court has officially handed down their unconstitutional, inhumane decision to overturn Roe v. Wade. I'm absolutely gutted, and I know you are, too. [https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif]
When you take away someone's ability to make their own decisions about their own bodies, health and life, they no longer have the full rights of every citizen to life and liberty. They no longer have basic freedom or bodily autonomy. They no longer have basic civil rights or civil liberties. That's the America that this decision just created.

We need to elect more progressive women to the halls of Congress in November — women who will never compromise when it comes to our reproductive freedom. Women who will vote to codify Roe v. Wade into federal law and reestablish nationwide access to full reproductive care.
But progressive women candidates across the country are going up against the far-right's anti-equality megadonors, so it's going to take all of us chipping in what we can to make sure they have the resources to fight back and win. That's why we set a rapid-response goal to raise $25,000 for Off the Sidelines before midnight tonight, and I'm counting on you to step up, friend:
The stakes of this fight have never been higher, and the urgency has never been greater. But with all of us fighting together, I know we can win.
Thank you,
Kirsten

Half a century of precedent was overturned by a far-right Supreme Court majority that includes three nominees of a president who LOST the popular vote. This is not what the majority wants.

To all of you out there who are shocked, angry, scared – please know that I feel your pain. I hear your anxiety.**** And that is why I say:** This fight is not over. We will NOT go back.**

We will not go back to a time when women were treated as second-class citizens. We will not go back to a time when personal health care decisions were made for us by politicians like Marco Rubio. We will not go back to a time when women died because they didn't have the basic human right of deciding when to start their own family.

clean_body: We must hold on to the Democratic House Majority, and that depends on holding my seat. | | | Breaking News: Roe v. Wade officially overturned = | = Peter, The moment we feared would arrive is upon us. The Supreme Court has officially overturned the life-saving legal precedent of Roe v. Wade , which protected abortion access as a constitutional right for decades. The decision to overturn Roe was once unthinkable, but now we know what can result from a GOP-controlled government. If Republicans win back the House in November, they have promised to do all they can to continue the onslaught against the right to choose. My opponent already supports an abortion ban nationwide with no exceptions. Together, we can fight back by winning this race and protecting the Democratic House Majority. = | | = | = | = | | = | = | = | = I was in high school before Roe was decided. I had friends who had horrible, back-alley abortions. I saw firsthand the toll it took on them. Then in my senior year, Roe v. Wade was decided and women finally had control over their own bodies. Now, our daughters and future generations will head back into the dark ages if we don’t do everything we can to protect reproductive freedom in Congress. We must hold on to the Democratic House Majority, and that depends on holding my seat. | = Everyone deserves to make their own decisions about their health and future. We must come together to protect access to safe and legal abortion. The call of the moment has never been stronger. There is no way around it: if we’re going to defend reproductive rights in the face of the Supreme Court’s deplorable decision, we must protect our Democratic majority, and that starts right here. = | = Thank you for your support of reproductive rights, Susan | | = Paid for by Susan Wild for Congress Susan Wild for Congress 1636 N Cedar Crest Blvd. #183 Allentown, PA 18104 United States If you wish to contribute by check, you can do so at the address above. # SCOTUS Overturns Roe v. Wade
## June 24, 2022
---
|
---
|
---
| Today, the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade, recognizing it as a states' rights issue.

Below is a statement from Erik Aadland, CD7 Republican candidate for Congress, on the Supreme Court's decision:
---
|
---
|
---
|
---
| "I agree with the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade and applaud their courage in turning this back to the states. As a father of three children, I am distinctly pro-Life. As a Congressman, I will take a stand against any federal funding of abortion, upholding the Hyde Amendment. Abortion should be a states' rights issue, and even though I strongly disagree with the permissiveness of the recent Colorado law (HB 1279) which puts us on par with the laws of North Korea and China, I also respect the legislative process for the people of Colorado to decide how this sensitive issue is managed within the state."
---
---
| |
---
|
---
|
## About Erik
---
| |
---
| Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being a net exporter of natural gas. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children.

Please donate $700 (the legal limit) or whatever amount you and your family can afford.** If you are willing to be listed as a person who endorses Justice Gustafson’s candidacy to be re-elected to the Montana Supreme Court in 2022, please send an email to grassroots@gustafsonformontana.com ... ****

**Hosting this event for Justice Gustafson in Whitefish are:****Judge Kitty Curtis (Ret.), Judge Stu Stadler (Ret.), Judge Jim Manley (Ret.), Former Montana State Senator Dan Weinberg, Scott Wurster, Paula & Frank Sweeney, Carole & Bart Erickson, Roger Sullivan and Commander John B. Herrington**. You have a very clear choice in the 2022 Montana Supreme Court race, the most important vote you will cast in the general election on November 8, 2022.Justice Ingrid Gustafson is seeking re-election to Montana’s highest court. In her nearly 20 years of judicial experience, the last five on the Montana Supreme Court, she has handled 1000s of cases and earned a reputation for being impartial and fair. She is non-partisan as required by Montana law, and works hard to keep politics out of the courtroom. Justice Gustafson has engaged in bettering our Montana community—starting and operating a drug court; piloting a child welfare court; serving on Yellowstone County’s Park Board, as President of the Amend Park Development Board, and as Big Sky State Games Soccer Commissioner; and decades-long coaching and mentoring youth soccer players and serving as a high school and collegiate soccer referee. She cares deeply about Montana and Montanans. Her opponent, Jim Brown, is a career lobbyist and a partisan politician who advocates for and benefits from out-of-state, large corporate money to promote his candidacy.“I don’t believe there is too much money in politics . . . it should be unlimited,” said Brown, in the documentary, _Dark Money_ , which exposed the influence of out-of-state corporate and illegal campaign activity in Montana. Brown represented the scandal-ridden out-of-state corporate money groups featured in the documentary. He has zero judicial experience and has never even represented a client before the Montana Supreme Court.In the recent primary, over $300,000 of dark money was spent by out-of-state corporations to buy her opponent a place on the general ballot. Although Montana law forbids judicial candidates from seeking partisan endorsements, Brown flouts these laws by participating in partisan events and accepting partisan endorsements.We cannot let this seat on the Montana Supreme Court be bought by out-of-state corporations and extreme partisans.

Friend, By now, you’ve probably seen the news: Roe v. Wade has officially been overturned by the U.S. Supreme Court! For millions of pro-life Americans, this is a momentous day. We officially have returned the power, on this issue, back to the states and the voters – as the Constitution intended. **For me, pro-life isn’t just a slogan. It’s my life’s work.** Over the course of a 30 year career in medicine, I’ve delivered more than 5,000 babies. And I was a conscientious objector — meaning I was never forced to perform an abortion during my medical career.
---
[| | |
---|---|---](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/80611874979feca4041ad8cde91a9694/37973/a3078cdb632c6cf1/1c5cbc337e92cf5ec3d6b838967d376c/37973)
**I’m proud of, and thankful for, the Supreme Court Justices who issued the majority ruling on this case.** Over the last weeks, they’ve withstood an unprecedented criminal leak and we’ve witnessed outright harassment and violence from the pro-abortion movement. But they held the line and issued the correct, and constitutional, ruling. So, what comes next? **First, I ask you to join me in praying for our nation.** The same radical activists “protesting” outside of Justices’ homes may well escalate their actions. Join my family and me in praying there is no violence. **Second, keep standing for life.** The end of Roe does not guarantee the end of abortion in America, but it does mean we have a renewed opportunity to protect the rights of the unborn in every single state. **If you live in Kansas** , commit to voting for the Value Them Both Amendment in August. If you don’t, keep up the pressure in your state for new laws that defend life. This is a day that was decades in the making, and it’s one worth celebrating. But the work continues, and I’m glad to have you standing with me in defense of life.

Hi friends,

We've been holding our breath for the last few weeks, and it has finally happened.

After nearly 50 years, the Supreme Court has announced its decision to strike down the landmark ruling of _Roe v. Wade_ , effectively taking away the right to choose – meaning access to safe and legal abortions is now up to state governments and legislatures.

This decision is devastating to many communities across the country, especially in states like Wisconsin, one of 13 states with a pre-Roe trigger law on the books. This over 100-year-old law automatically bans abortions now that _Roe_ is no longer in effect, per the Supreme Court's decision. As a result, millions across Wisconsin have lost a fundamental right.

**Abortion _is_ healthcare**. We all deserve the right to decide what happens with our bodies, and it's not the Supreme Court's decision to make.

Wade__. **While we knew this outcome was inevitable, it is still heartbreaking, disheartening, and dangerous for women across the country.** In Florida, where a person's right to choose after 15 weeks of pregnancy is not protected, this ruling could have strong ramifications that takes away this right from Floridian women. Peter,

The Supreme Court just overturned _Roe v. Wade_. At least 26 states will likely move swiftly to ban abortion following this ruling, meaning women in over half the country will no longer have power over their bodies and lives.

This ruling is a horrible tragedy for millions of women who deserve access to abortion care. Now that _Roe_ is overturned, women in more than half the states in the country have lost their right to safe and legal abortion.

And we know this is just the beginning of attacks on reproductive rights. Senate Minority Leader Mitch McConnell just said a ban that would make abortion illegal nationwide is "possible." That means regardless of whether you live in a blue state like Rhode Island or a red state, Republicans will work to take away access to abortion services.

I am devastated by this ruling and I will continue to fight for the right to choose – just as I've done throughout my career. As Treasurer, I worked to pass the Reproductive Privacy Act which codified _Roe_ into Rhode Island law, and I support the Equal Access to Abortion Act because a woman's right to reproductive health care should not depend on what type of health insurance she has.

In Congress, I will fight to ensure reproductive rights are protected for all, support codifying _Roe_ into federal law nationwide, and block states from enacting barriers to accessing abortion care.

Peter, The Supreme Court just overturned Roe v. Wade. At least 26 states will likely move swiftly to ban abortion following this ruling, meaning women in over half the country will no longer have power over their bodies and lives. This ruling is a horrible tragedy for millions of women who deserve access to abortion care. Now that Roe is overturned, women in more than half the states in the country have lost their right to safe and legal abortion. And we know this is just the beginning of attacks on reproductive rights. Senate Minority Leader Mitch McConnell just said a ban that would make abortion illegal nationwide is "possible." That means regardless of whether you live in a blue state like Rhode Island or a red state, Republicans will work to take away access to abortion services. I am devastated by this ruling and I will continue to fight for the right to choose – just as I've done throughout my career. As Treasurer, I worked to pass the Reproductive Privacy Act which codified Roe into Rhode Island law, and I support the Equal Access to Abortion Act because a woman's right to reproductive health care should not depend on what type of health insurance she has. | | We knew this day was coming, but that doesn't make it any less devastating and disheartening. **An extremist Republican majority on the Supreme Court, put in place by Donald Trump and Mitch McConnell, has overturned**** _Roe v. Wade_****.** Today’s radical decision will ensure that women in America today have fewer rights than their grandmothers had decades ago. Rights that have proven essential to health, economic participation, and the freedom for women to control their own bodies. We know the anti-abortion movement won’t stop here. Conservatives will now do everything in their power to criminalize abortion. I am furious and deeply saddened. But I am also determined to fight this in the weeks, months, and years ahead. Let me be clear: this is the most significant threat to Americans' constitutional rights in a generation. **The next steps are clear, and they're ours.** → The U.S. House and Senate must immediately try again to protect the right to a safe and legal abortion by passing ironclad protections into law. I believe it is absolutely our duty, and I will do everything in my power to see it done. → We must support our allies around the country as best we can, especially in states where abortions are now criminalized and the lives of pregnant Americans are very much at risk. → We must also insist that states where abortion is legal pass tough laws to block the judicial and law enforcement agencies in their state from cooperating with states trying to enforce criminal and civil laws against women or their doctors. clean_body: | | | | We knew this day was coming, but that doesn't make it any less devastating and disheartening. An extremist Republican majority on the Supreme Court, put in place by Donald Trump and Mitch McConnell, has overturned Roe v. Wade. Today’s radical decision will ensure that women in America today have fewer rights than their grandmothers had decades ago. Rights that have proven essential to health, economic participation, and the freedom for women to control their own bodies. We know the anti-abortion movement won’t stop here. Conservatives will now do everything in their power to criminalize abortion. I am furious and deeply saddened. But I am also determined to fight this in the weeks, months, and years ahead. Let me be clear: this is the most significant threat to Americans' constitutional rights in a generation. The next steps are clear, and they're ours. → The U.S. House and Senate must immediately try again to protect the right to a safe and legal abortion by passing ironclad protections into law. I believe it is absolutely our duty, and I will do everything in my power to see it done. → We must support our allies around the country as best we can, especially in states where abortions are now criminalized and the lives of pregnant Americans are very much at risk. → We must also insist that states where abortion is legal pass tough laws to block the judicial and law enforcement agencies in their state from cooperating with states trying to enforce criminal and civil laws against women or their doctors. I know this is a devastating blow to our constitutional rights and the right to live our lives free of government intrusion. We have a lot of work to do. This is a generational fight, and I'm all in. The worst-case scenario is here: Roe v. Wade is gone. But in the face of this dark reality, I have three words: Hold onto hope. Do not give into despair. We can still fight back, and we must. We can’t immediately undo the damage it took Republicans five decades to accomplish, but let’s be clear — we can fight back right now. Roe is on the ballot this November. **There are key fights happening right now at the state level where we can make an immediate difference -- to expand abortion protections or defeat attempts to restrict access.** In **Michigan** , there’s a campaign to amend the state’s constitution to affirm every person’s fundamental right to reproductive freedom. It could be a blueprint for many other states trying to affirm abortion protections. So we need to fight to get the amendment on the ballot — and then pass it this November. A Michigan coalition called Reproductive Freedom for All is leading the way. In **Kansas** , a measure on the ballot this August would amend the state Constitution to say that it does _not_ protect the right to abortion, overturning a decision by the state Supreme Court. Kansas is an island of access in a part of the country with already very severe restrictions, so this fight has especially high stakes. An organization called Kansans for Constitutional Freedom is fighting to defeat this ballot measure and to preserve reproductive freedom for women in Kansas and neighboring states. [_**Can you split a donation between Reproductive Freedom for All and Kansans for Constitutional Freedom today? They’re fighting their hearts out with grassroots campaigns on these ballot measures in Michigan and Kansas. clean_body: With Roe gone, we can still fight back. And we must. | | | The worst-case scenario is here: Roe v. Wade is gone. But in the face of this dark reality, I have three words: Hold onto hope. Do not give into despair. We can still fight back, and we must. We can’t immediately undo the damage it took Republicans five decades to accomplish, but let’s be clear — we can fight back right now. Roe is on the ballot this November. There are key fights happening right now at the state level where we can make an immediate difference -- to expand abortion protections or defeat attempts to restrict access. In Michigan , there’s a campaign to amend the state’s constitution to affirm every person’s fundamental right to reproductive freedom. It could be a blueprint for many other states trying to affirm abortion protections. So we need to fight to get the amendment on the ballot — and then pass it this November. A Michigan coalition called Reproductive Freedom for All is leading the way. In Kansas , a measure on the ballot this August would amend the state Constitution to say that it does not protect the right to abortion, overturning a decision by the state Supreme Court. Kansas is an island of access in a part of the country with already very severe restrictions, so this fight has especially high stakes. An organization called Kansans for Constitutional Freedom is fighting to defeat this ballot measure and to preserve reproductive freedom for women in Kansas and neighboring states. = | If you've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will process automatically: | | | | = | = | | = | = | | = | = Here’s the way I see it: This is a way we can channel our anger right now. I’m downright furious at the very idea that extremists on the Supreme Court think they can force their personal and religious views on the rest of America by rolling back abortion rights. And I’m determined to keep fighting back. If this decision feels like a personal attack, that’s because it is. Extremists are trying to send us back to the days when women had no control over our own bodies and our own futures. But I’ve got news for them: We still have the power to fight back. And we’ve got to take the fight to the state level, where the rubber’s hitting the road now that Roe v. Wade’s national protections are gone. = And please, take a moment to take care of yourself today and check in on someone else who’s hurting. These attacks are meant to exhaust us. Meant to drain us of our will to fight. But we can’t let them succeed. We truly make each other stronger — so we’ve got to have each other’s backs. I’m thinking of you and everyone who’s reeling from today’s devastating news. Like me, you probably weren't surprised when we learned the Hunter Biden laptop story was 100% true. Of course, it was true. It was obvious it was true all along.
Just like the Wuhan Lab Leak. And the safety of keeping schools open during Covid. That schools are teaching Critical Race Theory and trans extremism. That there were irregularities in the 2020 election. That inflation is the fault of big-spending politicians. And that liberals
called for defunding the police.
The Left - in the White House, in Congress, in the media - lied about all those things. Conservatives may be outraged about this, but we're not surprised anymore.
There was never any question that they were lying. The question is: What is the Left still lying about today?
Climate change? A new Iran nuclear deal? China? Big Tech? January 6th? The correct answer is: All of the Above.
That's why the Conservative Partnership Institute launched CPI Studios - and why we are expanding them this year.

Rep. Jim Jordan (Ohio)

The only way to get true conservative messages out of Washington is through CPI Studios. And the only way to grow CPI Studios is with your help.

body:
Republicans are already planning to try to pass a federal abortion ban if they take control of Congress.

| The Supreme Court just struck down _Roe v. Wade_ , overturning a precedent that protected reproductive freedom for a generation.

While we knew this was coming, it’s still difficult. I am worried, and I am angry. But that doesn’t mean I’m quitting. I am going to continue to fight for our rights, and I hope you will join me.

Today’s decision is not the end. The Court has put this issue squarely back in the hands of the American people, ruling that the right to an abortion is an issue for the people through the democratic process in the states or the U.S. Congress.

Republicans are already planning to try to pass a federal abortion ban if they take control of Congress, and both of my Republican opponents are all in up to make it happen. _**We can’t let that happen.**_

It is so important we win races like this one to stop Republicans from taking back the majority in the House of Representatives.

name: Candace Owens, Co-founder of BLEXIT
subject: The most personal email I’ve ever sent you
body:
This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the
[View this message in your browser](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zgbhlsvlojpp5bbs0l9guee9bsrdekpn3f6d89sg_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1ge1oj2c3h238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq2d9ieuqfbdbie4rrcdljkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbo61d9kmpgn6s70e5jm1dbh66rb5cpkscq74srhmdin1p3lc6rj9dlnmepj0ohgsv970sj2cpob4pjgsipm6o3i6pj38ppl6hjr5cj66pgb4pj0s2qm6o70mkoj3d9hmlp2bs)
[](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z2ru2ckoau0g5kkst4e9a7b3d2mjik3ak56jhngo_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1ge1oj2c3h2bs)

Friend,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zsjre4o0rqun2fmr33sb7pcidjmm551ipv5s0dt0_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1ge1oj2c3h2bs)

**_Now I 'll share my story_... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I've dealt with racism... _**I 've even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Friend, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $10, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zfqcu90bs4nl25ld9c3gotbs3n1hqj9d031som9g_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1ge1oj2c3h2bs)

I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I 'm not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z7jnmf8mvt5se7qs49d0ldlif26f2lrh2fsj61ug_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1ge1oj2c3h2bs)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z6tbcvj5kh5kve6nrv2pdfehlv6c8mat8jv2pqtg_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1ge1oj2c3h2bs)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z14brmerg5lqo310bsot3ilt0bt32s0veqa9megg_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1ge1oj2c3h2bs)

* **Teaching History: **Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zg1en7so0mthe3logttubk3qmo0rbb4t2qad3pi8_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1ge1oj2c3h2bs)

* **Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore.

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. [_**Please support BLEXIT 's events and help us spread our message by donating here >>>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zffqsr5retuairkqo0cuv3nvoh1ibbreabojssoo_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1ge1oj2c3h2bs)

What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor.

This is personal to me.

I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot.

Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today:

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z3se4j211a7te0vft073lf8b6urc95o68rb0jqk8_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1ge1oj2c3h2bs)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2znndc91umgm3jhmr43me6v81i7q0hnri46406o5o_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1ge1oj2c3h2bs)
[_**Donate $50 >>>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zo01rtsslib86k68maogtis0tvk1k1abl6uioha0_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1ge1oj2c3h2bs)
[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2ztq169iq6fqjuaijpnq26k316m8k4ch3sf9lfte0_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1ge1oj2c3h2bs)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z8ob6hb866o0ll7ttft5jnea56rvdg5ki1vd0u78_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1ge1oj2c3h2bs)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z148f0d6tr6bci0qiivsq4n4eojpim3fnvqmn3sg_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1ge1oj2c3h2bs)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zssjgbc16rjts01hganoe6hdjc09kn8qd3p9vse0_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1ge1oj2c3h2bs)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zlemc2evhmcdklfe6chrt2dhd9h9vonn7mbad3m0_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1ge1oj2c3h2bs)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2ztdvb34p5q0grhkv0bth64arleu7b1sff0aqj8b0_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1ge1oj2c3h2bs)

This is my last message to you before you close this email.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in faith, family, and freedom. At the end of the day, our message to urban communities is about love and empowerment.

My burning desire is to use my voice and change the direction of our urban communities and the country. The BLEXIT Foundation has a real impact, and I am inviting you to join our cause.

[_**Please consider making the most generous donation you can today by clicking here.**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z718mutjulj4kadcgstpkstapiv45p0cgl58qtb8_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1ge1oj2c3h2bs)

Thank you, Friend.

Candace Owens
President
BLEXIT Foundation

clean_body: This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the Friend, This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation. Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation. For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop. In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities. Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture. Now I 'll share my story... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities. Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking. We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals. This is WRONG. I've dealt with racism... I 've even received death threats. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable. But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up. I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters. I am breaking the rules. It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... I 'm not doing that. You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country. So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss). When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing. Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for: School Choice: Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools. The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. Criminal Justice Reform: The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities. Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message. Entrepreneurship: I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire. BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. Teaching History: Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message. The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore. The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor. This is personal to me. I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot. Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today: This is my last message to you before you close this email. The BLEXIT Foundation believes in faith, family, and freedom. At the end of the day, our message to urban communities is about love and empowerment. My burning desire is to use my voice and change the direction of our urban communities and the country. The BLEXIT Foundation has a real impact, and I am inviting you to join our cause. Thank you, Friend.
