name: Richard Blumenthal
subject: The conservative-controlled Supreme Court just abandoned our civil rights
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Blumenthal for Connecticut
body:
[ ](http://salsa4.salsalabs.com/dia/track.jsp?v=2&c=8oeNE60%2Fu6wQKGqMhbIUXpR1KuaxAh8b&url=http%3A%2F%2Frichardblumenthal.com%2F)
What just happened is sickening. Unconscionable. Friend, six conservative U.S. Supreme Court justices just betrayed their own promised commitment to legal precedent and eviscerated the freedom of women to make their own healthcare decisions.
The Court's decision is an endorsement of government control over personal health decisions - and it has greenlighted so-called "liberty-loving" Republicans' bans on abortions. The same Republicans who didn't want to be told to wear a mask on airplanes to keep everyone safe from COVID-19, are now perfectly happy to take complete control over the bodies and destinies of American women. It means more than 30 million women have been stripped of a fundamental human and civil right - in the United States of America.
I know you likely share my anger right now. Many of you are probably feeling sad, angry, scared, disgusted. But please, hear me when I say this: We will take this egregious decision back to the American people. They will very soon have a choice to strengthen the numbers of those who will _enshrine_ federal abortion protections into law - or give power to a party that ignores the rule of law, attacks our democracy, and now steals women's freedom to control their own bodies.
**The conservative-controlled Supreme Court may have abandoned our civil rights, but Democrats have not. That 's why I'm resolved to win re-election, secure a working Democratic majority, and pass legislation that codifies _Roe v. Wade_ into law.**
**[This fight isn't over. So if you're with me, chip in a donation of whatever you can spare right now. Harness anger into action and help me keep this Senate seat and keep Democrats in control of Congress.](https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/blumenthal-email?refcode=jtk1193-fr-nd&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500)**
Today is a dark and inhumane day for our nation. But the well-being and very lives of tens of millions women are _counting_ on us - grassroots fighters everywhere - to protect their human and civil rights.
We cannot give up. We _**must**_ make things better. Thank you for doing your part, and thank you for your support. You have my word, I will do everything in my power to ensure reproductive freedoms for all.
Dick

name: Jocelyn Benson
subject: It’s all the same fight
disclaimer_text:
Paid for by
Jocelyn Benson for Secretary of State
body:
Friend,

When the Dobbs v Jackson Women’s Health Organization draft opinion that would overturn Roe v. Wade leaked in early May, I said “it’s all the same fight.” Now more than ever, this bears repeating.

The fight for democracy is the fight for freedom is the fight for choice.

The direct result of the Supreme Court’s final ruling announced today is that millions of women in Michigan lose nearly every right to make choices about their own bodies and futures -- and could be subject to a heavily restrictive anti-choice law that dates back nearly a century.

This is not an isolated decision or a single moment. This the cumulative effect of a 40-year assault on our rights by extremists on the far right, from the Federalist Society and law schools, to circuit courts and the three most recent appointees to the Supreme Court. Candidates around the country for every office are using their platforms to attack womens’ rights, regardless of the office’s responsibility.

These extremists and their hand-picked judges will go even further. They will strip as many federal protections as possible from those who need them most. They will "return" these decisions to the states, where in many cases the deck is already stacked due to partisan gerrymandering, judicial appointments, and voter suppression.

The Dobbs decision essentially eliminates the constitutional right to privacy, which opens the door to the elimination of many other protections and freedoms - from contraception to marriage equality. And today’s opinion sets the stage to eliminate voting as a fundamental constitutional right, and all the protections that come with it.

This is not some far off apocalyptic vision of the future – it’s what could happen in the next five years.

So what can we do about it? State and local elections matter more than ever. And having fair, accurate elections takes on even more importance. The majority of Americans support a woman’s right to choose. It’s up to all of us to make sure election results reflect that majority.

The preservation of every constitutional right we have left depends on whether we exercise the right to vote – and make sure every vote is counted.

Like I said: The fight for democracy is the fight for freedom is the fight for choice.

It’s all the same fight.

I’m grateful that you’re with me in it.

-Jocelyn

Team, The Supreme Court has overturned _Roe v. Wade_ after five decades of legal precedent. **In Indiana, the days are now numbered to get a safe and legal abortion.** In July, the Indiana Republican Party will hold a special session to ban a woman's right to legal and safe abortions. As seen from last weekend, the Indiana GOP has become the Party of extremists who care more about their national agenda than delivering a better future for Hoosier families.
It’s no secret that only about **17%** of Hoosiers believe abortion should be criminalized under all circumstances. And, about **56%** of Hoosiers have opposed extreme abortion measures like Mike Pence’s 2016 law — _which forced women to have a funeral for stillborn babies._
Let’s be clear — ending Roe does not end abortions. It ends access to safe and legal abortions – (_the law of the land for nearly 50 years_) — especially for vulnerable communities across Indiana and nationwide.
**And make no mistake, Democrats do not root for abortion.** We understand that it is sometimes a necessary procedure. If a woman is raped, she should not be forced to have her rapist’s baby. If a girl experiences incest, she should not be forced to have a child. And, if a woman’s life is on the line — she should not be forced to die.
**We know that healthcare decisions should be made with a doctor or health care professional – not politicians. If you agree,[make a contribution today to help us elect more pro-choice champions across Indiana.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46922900/352335954/1643342139?refcode=idp-em-220624-scotus&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4Y2QyOTQ1Zi1kZGYzLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9JqhYwbC9gjxr9y_6w9SAJorkU9pVBoldaw_eep0uG4=)**

Team,

The Supreme Court reversed nearly 50 years of precedent and overturned _Roe v. Wade_.

I believe the government has no business getting between a woman and her doctor. The Court's decision threatens every Arizonan's constitutional right to exercise control of their own body, and it cannot stand - **we must codify _Roe_ into law**.

Arizona is one of 23 states that have an existing abortion ban on the books. And with the Supreme Court's decision, abortion in Arizona could be restricted immediately.

We all know that this ban won't stop abortion, it will only limit access to safe and legal abortion, particularly for our most vulnerable: Poor women, abused women, victims of rape or incest, and transgender folks. **We cannot let this decision remain in place.**

I was proud to vote for the _Women 's Health Protection Act_, which would codify _Roe_ into federal law. Unfortunately, the Senate has failed to do the same. We must urgently demand the Senate renew efforts to codify _Roe_.

Team, we are entering uncharted territory and Arizonans need our help. The Abortion Fund of Arizona is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit that provides direct assistance to people seeking abortion care in Arizona. Earlier today six members of the highest Court of our land decided to strip away a woman's right to reproductive freedom at a moment when it is under historic attack in Republican controlled states across our country! This outrageous decision from the right-wing packed Supreme Court will deny millions of American women their well established Constitutional rights and overturns decades of established legal precedent under Roe v Wade that guarantees women the right to chose their own destiny.
This was an ideological, results driven ruling — not a rule of law decision. And it will do permanent damage to the legitimacy of the Supreme Court. But for now, we must take this question of liberty to the people. Americans don’t want state elected officials dictating their most personal, private decisions. Many states have laws in place that, with this decision, will immediately ban abortion, even in cases of rape or incest. Lives will be put at risk — particularly the lives of those in the most difficult situations.
**[Pledge Now to fight back!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46926004/352348777/614319739?refcode=em220624rrpetition&refcode2=f1708c66-e3f3-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&contactdata=r9%2BVf%2BE09JAWsbI9GgKECmBqH5IAt9laqBawUr7fx6U%2Fj9BfVrqtWF1NLh6iIeXV&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODIzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMTcwOGM2Ni1lM2YzLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=iSkZOd9DY_ic4L4xMQyYjaG_fr84LlIDRKvpciwxXGI=&emci=e3d6f62a-d8f3-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=f1708c66-e3f3-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=2216363)**
And make no mistake: knocking down Roe is just STEP ONE of the extremist right-wing plan for America. STEP TWO is to elect a Congress that will pass a national law outlawing abortion. That law would override state laws, like the one we have here in Maryland, that protect the right to choose within our state lines.
That’s why the 2022 elections are of paramount importance. We need to elect a Congress that will enact the Women’s Health Protection Act, a national law to codify Roe v. Wade in federal statute. That's the only way to protect reproductive freedom nationwide and stop Republicans from writing their own Handmaid’s Tale for our country.
We know Americans are overwhelmingly on the side of reproductive freedom. We must get out the vote this November to protect it!
We've been through a lot. But this is a clarion Call to Action.
Together we can do this!
Chris

Our only chance to reverse this decision and enshrine women's reproductive rights into law is through congressional action – and protecting and expanding our pro-choice Senate majority depends on defending this seat in New Hampshire.

Today a radical conservative majority on the Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_ and dismantled a woman’s right to make her own healthcare decisions. There’s a lot to be angry about, friends. And I am really angry. This decision has immediately triggered extreme abortion bans in Republican-led states, and many more are expected to follow. Republicans have been plotting for this moment for decades. Now that it’s here, they have every intention of passing and implementing laws that ban abortions without any exceptions for incest, rape, or the life of the woman. And some are even working to put women and doctors in jail for seeking or performing abortions — like the law we fought hard to overturn in New Mexico. But we will not let Republicans and their handpicked, radical conservative majority of the Supreme Court win. There’s a lot of work ahead. I will continue the fight, alongside Senate Democrats, to protect the right to choose and pass the _Women’s Health Protection Act_. I will work in my home state to build out the resources that will be needed to provide safe healthcare to women who soon will not be able to in their home states. subject: The Red Wave Is Not Just Inevitable, It's Also Conservative
body:
Voters understand that the hour is late. Conservative warriors are being summoned by citizens ready to fight for the things that they love. | | | |
---
| | |
## **The Red Wave Is Not Just Inevitable, It’s Also Conservative**
---
| A political tsunami is coming for Democrats. The resounding victory of Republican newcomer Mayra Flores in the special election for Texas’ 34th congressional district signals what most political pundits and election prognosticators already know: a red tidal wave will soon sweep away a Democrat Party in thrall to far-left radicals and progressive extremists.
However, as impressive as Flores’ seven-point victory was in the nation’s second-most heavily Hispanic congressional district — a district which Joe Biden carried by four points — the real impact will be felt in state legislatures.
What the red tsunami portends is not merely a coming Republican majority in Congress and state capitols, but a realignment that propels conservatives into power. All across the nation in one primary after another, conservative state legislative candidates are defeating milquetoast establishment and moderate candidates.
This is encouraging as it is in our home states where our freedoms and way of life will either be won or lost. The renewed focus on states from conservatives is a game-changing development. Indeed, the State Freedom Caucus Network was launched in December 2021 with this specific mission in mind: to create a bulwark outside Washington D.C. that will protect as many Americans as possible from both the neo-Marxist policies coming out of the modern Democrat Party and the fecklessness that is a hallmark of establishment elites in the Republican Party.
The strategy appears to be working.
For example, Iowa Gov. Kim Reynolds supported a slew of conservative challengers against liberal Republican incumbents beholden to teachers’ unions and antagonistic toward school choice. Six establishment incumbents in the Iowa State House [lost to pro-parent conservative challengers](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=ece2b78f7e&e=64ecec6d03) with all but one of Reynolds’ endorsed candidates defeating their entrenched opponents.
This stands in stark contrast to South Dakota Gov. Kristi Noem, a darling of the Washington elite, who conversely supported eleven moderate candidates. Incredibly, Noem even backed Democrats who recently switched parties against budding South Dakota Freedom Caucus members. Only four of her preferred legislators won their primaries.
For a sitting governor with a national profile, these results illustrate two realities: that Noem is fundamentally out of touch with her own electorate and that voters are backing candidates who will actually fight to preserve freedom.
In Georgia, members of the Georgia Freedom Caucus were targeted by establishment GOP forces seeking to rid themselves of meddlesome legislators with actual principles. David Ralston, the liberal Republican Speaker of the House, redrew district lines to[ punish conservative state legislators](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=498535e045&e=64ecec6d03) like Rep. Philip Singleton. While Singleton was forced to retire, Ralston’s overall efforts largely backfired as voters propelled every other member of the Freedom Caucus to victory. They even tossed out Rep. Bonnie Rich, the loyal lieutenant who [redrew district lines](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=e3085b94e0&e=64ecec6d03) for Ralston to punish conservatives.
In South Carolina, thirteen out of the fourteen members of the South Carolina Freedom Caucus won their primaries while four establishment incumbents lost to freedom-minded conservative challengers. In Nevada, Freedom Caucus incumbents won all their races with only one that remains undecided.
North Dakota Gov. Doug Borgum spent over $1 million to back moderate or left-leaning Republican candidates. He suffered [similar results](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=97be7489e4&e=64ecec6d03) as Noem with conservatives crushing their opponents in primaries across the state.
The undercurrents of the red wave are clear: voters are in full revolt against the cultural and economic progressivism that is ravaging families and threatening our ability to live free. Voters are equally tired of the Republicans who enable and empower radicalized Democrats to trample our rights with woke nonsense.
It is for this very moment that the State Freedom Caucus Network exists. The Network stands ready to support liberty-minded state lawmakers with the resources, policy knowledge, and procedural strategies they need to ensure the rights of their citizens are protected and the progressive policies crushing American households are dismantled.
Establishment Republicans push the oft-repeated talking points that only weak-kneed, or as they call them, “moderate,” GOP candidates are electable. This is, like most conventional wisdom, only conventional and not actually wise.
On the other hand, voters understand that the hour is late. Unchecked progressivism, which has fully captured America’s cultural and political institutions after a decades-long march, now threatens the very freedom that undergirds our republic. Conservative warriors are being summoned by citizens ready to fight for the things that they love.
The red _conservative_ wave is indeed upon us and candidates who do not stand with the American people will be washed out to sea.

_Andy Roth is the President of the State Freedom Caucus Network. Check out the full article from The Federalist [here](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=1f6f21f545&e=64ecec6d03). _

Jesse Reising comes from a long line of Central Illinoisans, with his ancestors arriving by horseback among the first 300 settlers in Decatur in the 1830s. After graduating from Yale, Jesse achieved all 3 of his goals. As a federal prosecutor, Jesse prosecuted white-collar criminals and foreign business executives who were manipulating American economic markets. The cases Jesse prosecuted resulted in the recovery of over $100 million for the American taxpayer. Now Jesse is running for Congress so he can continue to protect taxpayers, strengthen the economy, stand by law enforcement, empower veterans to succeed, and protect the agriculture industry that is vital to Illinois.

Make no mistake: this isn’t the end of the Republican's assault on abortion rights. It’s just the beginning.

| Peter,

Today, our worst fears were confirmed when the Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade._

For so long, this decision was unthinkable. _Roe v. Wade_ has been the law of the land for almost all of my life. I am angry that we have to again fight for abortion access and reproductive rights when this should be settled law.

I’ve been committed to protecting abortion rights throughout my career. I was a proud co-sponsor of the Women’s Health Protection Act last year, which would enact federal protections for abortions because the right to choose should be a guarantee, no matter which state folks call home.

Make no mistake: this isn’t the end of the Republican's assault on abortion rights. It’s just the beginning. **The GOP is already mobilizing to ban abortion on the federal level if they take back the majority.**

The Republicans are gaining steam across the country, and every race matters in our fight to stop the assaults on our rights. This decision proves that we can’t take anything for granted.

The American people -- particularly in red states -- now confront the reality that access to safe abortions will be as restricted as it once was over 50 years ago. Let me be very clear: It has never been more urgent that we protect and expand our majorities so we can pass legislation like the Women’s Health Protection Act to codify Roe v. Wade into federal law. The Court’s decision is a stark reminder that who we elect to office can have a lifetime of influence -- and for generations to come. subject: History has proven Hillsdale correct
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vsuf5xrhqN

For Hillsdale College, independence is invaluable. Hillsdale
refuses to accept a single penny of federal or state funding-not
even indirectly in
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osuf5xrhqN

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear Fellow American,

For Hillsdale College, independence is
invaluable.

Hillsdale refuses to accept a single penny of
federal or state funding-not even indirectly in the form of
federal or state student grants and loans.

This independence frees Hillsdale from
corrupting and unconstitutional regulations and allows us to
remain true to the college's 1844 mission: to provide the kind of
education needed to preserve "the inestimable blessings of civil
and religious liberty."

The kind of education offered by Hillsdale is
rare in American higher education today. There are several
reasons for this. Let me mention two important ones.

One reason is that since the 1960s, Left-wing
progressives have increasingly come to dominate American colleges
and universities. They have thrown out the old mission statements
and restructured their curricula to promote "progressive"
ideology.

Another contributing factor to the decline of
American higher education has been the massive influx of taxpayer
funding to colleges and universities-funding that comes with
regulatory strings attached.

Going back to the 1950s, when the direct
distribution of federal-taxpayer money first became available to
colleges, Hillsdale refused to accept such funds.

Since that time, Hillsdale's Board of
Trustees has pledged several times to resist any attempts by the
government to regulate its internal affairs. Hillsdale was almost
alone in seeing the dangers posed by federal funding.

History has proven Hillsdale's decision to be
correct-and Hillsdale's status as America's leading liberal arts
college that reaches and teaches increasing millions of citizens
nationwide stands as proof.

Hillsdale's independence also means that all
of the scholarships, grants, and loans that our students need to
attend Hillsdale College must be privately funded through the
generosity of citizens like you, who understand the importance of
education to liberty.

Indeed, all of Hillsdale's work is entirely
dependent on private support-and as I already mentioned, this
work is by no means confined to our Michigan campus.

Hillsdale radiates its educational mission
nationwide through its many outreach efforts on behalf of
liberty.

Consider our monthly speech digest, Imprimis.
Now in its 49th year, Imprimis reaches more than 5.7 million
households and businesses nationwide.

Hillsdale also produces online courses, and
we offer them free of charge to any citizen wishing to learn.
Over 2.5 million citizens have already enrolled in one or more of
these courses, which cover such topics as the Constitution,
American history, and free market economics.

Hillsdale also extends its mission into
American K-12 education. Our Barney Charter School Initiative has
already helped establish over 20 Hillsdale-affiliated classical
K-12 charter schools in over eleven states.

In addition, Hillsdale provides, free of
charge, an American classical K-12 curriculum -including American
civics-to a growing network of educators and homeschoolers.

Our effective educational outreach on behalf
of liberty has a tremendous impact-and in this time of increasing
threats to American liberty, we aim to expand these outreach
efforts even further.

None of this would be possible without your
support.

That's why I'm asking you to partner with
Hillsdale by making a generous donation today.

Your gift is vital to the continuation and
expansion of Hillsdale's work to promote informed patriotism.

You can give safely and securely online here:
https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/price-of-independence

With your help, Hillsdale will remain a
beacon of genuine independence … and will continue to work
tirelessly to preserve America's great heritage of liberty for
future generations.

All of us at Hillsdale College are deeply
grateful for your partnership.

Best regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since
1844

Like you friend, I’m furious, I’m sad, and I’m asking: what now?

In Pennsylvania, abortion is still safe and legal. For now. What happens in November will determine whether or not that remains the case.

That's why I am still crisscrossing the Commonwealth to support Democrats up and down the ballot. We must elect Josh Shapiro to be our next Governor and John Fetterman as our next US Senator.

But I can't do this alone. That's why I'm humbly asking for your help. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mkweb]

We need everyone in this fight. Your support will help us elect Democrats and keep Pennsylvania blue. We can’t give up. Everything is on the line.

| Dear Friend, I'm writing this letter to you today because, quite frankly, David Daleiden cannot. You may remember David as the undercover journalist who spent 30 months investigating and capturing video evidence of Planned Parenthood 's top leadership --- medical directors, national program directors, even its Senior Director of Medical Services -- **callously negotiating the harvesting and sale of aborted baby body parts.** **And now, he's been charged with nine bogus felonies.** **[Which is why I'm asking you to make an emergency donation to the DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND right away.](http://trk.readactnews._bcPjLFwA)** You see, after David released the shocking videos of the illegal and disgusting actions of abortion executives, Kamala Harris, then California's Attorney General, colluded with Planned Parenthood to file felony charges against David... _**... Kamala Harris even ordered the California Department of Justice to raid David's home and confiscate his unpublished videos.**_ I won't sugarcoat it. If not cleared of these charges, David faces steep fines and years in state penitentiary and the consequences of being a convicted felon. While Kamala Harris --- a bought-and-paid-for ally of the abortion industry --- is sitting one heartbeat away from the presidency. That's the bad news. But here's the good news... David is fighting back. In fact, he's taking another opportunity to drag more of Planned Parenthood's dark criminality into the spotlight with two new federal lawsuits. That's right. The Thomas More Society has filed a federal civil rights lawsuit in California on behalf of David against former California Attorney General and now VicePresident Kamala Harris for prosecuting David in bad faith, twisting and perverting California's anti-eavesdropping law to persecute a citizen journalist because of his political views. Then the Thomas More Society filed a defamation (libel) lawsuit in federal court in New York against Planned Parenthood, which said David created a "fake" and "false" "smear campaign" against Planned Parenthood. In other words, the best defense is a good offense. The truth is we could no longer let David suffer such a trampling of his free speech and due process rights without a counterattack. The timing couldn't be more important. This is a critical opportunity to put Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and the rest of the abortion industry on trial for conspiring to silence David in order to cover-up their illegal activities. **[That's where your emergency donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND comes in --- by giving today you can stand with David in his hour of need.](http://trk.readactnews.)** The reality is. . . You couldn't be there when David entered the dark underbelly of the abortion industry --- sitting across the table from abortionists haggling over the price of baby body parts with cold-blooded clarity... "I want a Lamborghini." You couldn't be there as David saw with his own eyes the preborn children who had been killed with great precision and delicacy to preserve their organs for maximum profit. You couldn't be there when the videos were released and Kamala Harris and Planned Parenthood conspired to crush David with trumped up legal charges and an armed raid on his home in which they seized laptops, hard-drives, and recording equipment. And you couldn't be there with David (our criminal defense team was there) when he voluntarily appeared in both Texas and California for booking and processing --- fingerprinted and photographed for a mugshot like a common criminal. But, now, this is the reality... there is something you can do. **[You can make an emergency donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND to help vindicate this pro-life hero.](http://trk.readactnews.)** My name is Tom Brejcha. I'm the president and chief counsel of the Thomas More Society --- a not-for-profit law firm underwriting and helping to spearhead David's criminal defense. The Thomas More Society is proud to have defended many renowned pro-life and religious leaders in America's pro-life movement such as Joe, Ann, and Eric Scheidler, the Pro-Life Action League, Shawn Carney and 40 Days for Life, Abby Johnson, the Susan B. Anthony List, David Bereit, Lila Rose and Live Action, Students for Life, Sidewalk Advocates for Life, Created Equal, former Kansas Attorney General Phill Kline, the March for Life, and many more. Because when dark forces like Planned Parenthood unleash their full might to legally, financially, and personally destroy our clients --- **we fight back.** I have to tell you, despite all that David is facing, his spirits remain high. Of course, I've never known anyone in this kind of position who didn't feel an empty pit in his stomach. But David's not giving up. His willingness to fight back is a true profile in Pro-Life courage. Now I'll get right down to it... **We anticipate David's legal defense will cost us more than $6 million. That's right, SIX MILLION DOLLARS.** In addition to the criminal case and the new federal civil rights and defamation lawsuits, we're currently representing David in THREE other cases.
* The civil lawsuit filed by Planned Parenthood where we are appealing the jury's verdict, along with the judge's order permanently banning David from doing any more undercover journalism against Planned Parenthood. Recently, we posted a $700,000 appeal bond to keep Planned Parenthood's nasty collection agents from harassing him with collection agents and even seizing his belongings. We're fighting back, but we'll need your help.

* The civil lawsuit brought by the National Abortion Federation and the "gag order" injunction that still prohibits David from releasing any more of his video evidence exposing Planned Parenthood's illegal fetal tissue business. And now, in light of the Planned Parenthood civil lawsuit, NAF has moved for summary judgment - they want a ruling against David without a trial at all!

* And finally, the civil lawsuit filed by Planned Parenthood personnel in federal court in Seattle, where we just achieved a victory for a second time on appeal, but it appears we may need at least a third victory on appeal before this case ends.

That's why David needs your financial support today. **[And that's why I'm praying you will donate $35 or more to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND right away.](http://trk.readactnews.-5JjifA)** I won't guess how much you're able to send today. Whether it's $35, $50, $75, $125, $250, $500, $1,000 or more... ... I will only say that time is of the essence. So I do ask that you make your donation as soon as you can. **This truly is a "David versus Goliath" type of battle --- with Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and the radical left arrayed against our "David."** It's a grave injustice that David is the one being hit with felony charges and massive civil penalties while Planned Parenthood (so far, at least) has gone unpunished. By clearing David of these charges... you and I can allow him to continue with his incredibly important lifesaving work. Remember, over 12 million people on YouTube alone watched the shocking footage he captured. Since that time, 26 states --- over half the country -- have moved to strip Planned Parenthood of taxpayer funding. It's no wonder Planned Parenthood and their allies want to destroy David. They'd love to see him rotting away in penitentiary rather than exposing their criminal and inhumane activities. You and I cannot let that happen. **[So please don't delay. Donate $35, $50, $100, or more to stand with David Daleiden today.](http://trk.readactnews._pKhXRHqg)** I've asked my staff to let me know as soon as we get it so I can let David know that you're standing with him. I know he'll be deeply touched by your generous support. May God Bless You, Tom Brejcha

body:
Millions of people across the country just lost their constitutional right to safe, legal abortion — the right to make their own decisions about their own bodies. And it's all because the Supreme Court decided to turn its back on nearly 50 years of precedent and pursue its own ultraconservative agenda instead.
We know that this moment is absolutely devastating, but it's also a matter of life and death for people in every corner of this country.
That's why we cannot stop fighting. We cannot lose hope — because that's exactly what anti-choice extremists want. They want us to give up and stand by as they pass even more extreme restrictions across America.
We refuse to sit on the sidelines and watch our nation slip backward, and we're counting on you to take a stand with us today. We're looking for 50,000 members of this team to add their voices with Kirsten's before midnight tonight to show that the majority of the American people support access to the full range of reproductive health care — but we're still waiting for your signature, friend:
If you agree that safe, legal abortion should be accessible nationwide, add your name right now.

Thank you for speaking out alongside us at this urgent moment,
Team Gillibrand

subject: We must codify abortion rights

body:
| Hi Peter, This is a dark day in American history: the Supreme Court has overturned Roe. With countless states already outlawing abortion, this is a direct attack on reproductive rights. I am angry. I am hurt. And I am _very_ worried for people who will need reproductive health care in the coming years. This is an attack on our community, making essential health care more difficult. **And yes, abortion and reproductive care _is_ health care. **We need doctors to help people make medical decisions, not politicians or judges. We cannot accept this result and must demand that Congress pass legislation to codify abortion rights at once. I’ve said this to you before and I believe it bears repeating: I feel as if I’ve been told that every election over the past decade was “the most important election of our lifetime”. For what it’s worth, I believe that every election is important, full stop. Everyone needs to make their voice count in every election. But Peter, this year really is different. They keep coming for our rights. They keep undermining our democracy. We cannot allow that to stand. Today feels like a punch to the gut, but we must stand as strong as ever and work harder than ever. Let me make it as clear as I can: **I unequivocally support reproductive rights and will be a voice and advocate, voting to secure them as a member of Congress.** \- Eric \--
Eric Sorensen
Meteorologist | Candidate for Congress (IL-17)

**Harriet Hageman statement on Supreme Court abortion ruling **
---
Harriet Hageman, Republican candidate for the U.S. House of Representatives in Wyoming, today issued the following statement regarding the U.S. Supreme Court ruling on abortion:
“This is a literal life-saving victory for millions of unborn babies, who would otherwise be snuffed out by abortion, which has already claimed the lives of tens of millions of others under Roe v. Wade. This ruling restores the proper role of the courts in these matters by correctly returning decisions regarding abortion law to the states. This is just a first step in the fight for life. There is more work to be done on behalf of the unborn, and as Wyoming’s next congresswoman, I will always vote for the right to life for the innocent unborn.
“Liz Cheney, however, has lost the ability to be an advocate for anyone, including unborn babies, since she has shredded any chance that she can effectively represent Wyoming any longer. As soon as Democrats are finished using her on the January 6th Committee, they will discard her. And she trashed her relationships with Republicans a long time ago, which means she has no allies with whom to work on issues that are important to Wyomingites. When I am the next congresswoman from Wyoming, I will always be an effective advocate for our wonderful state and never forget who hired me for the job.”

###

clean_body: | | | | Harriet Hageman statement on Supreme Court abortion ruling Harriet Hageman, Republican candidate for the U.S. House of Representatives in Wyoming, today issued the following statement regarding the U.S. Supreme Court ruling on abortion: “This is a literal life-saving victory for millions of unborn babies, who would otherwise be snuffed out by abortion, which has already claimed the lives of tens of millions of others under Roe v. Wade. This ruling restores the proper role of the courts in these matters by correctly returning decisions regarding abortion law to the states. This is just a first step in the fight for life. There is more work to be done on behalf of the unborn, and as Wyoming’s next congresswoman, I will always vote for the right to life for the innocent unborn. “Liz Cheney, however, has lost the ability to be an advocate for anyone, including unborn babies, since she has shredded any chance that she can effectively represent Wyoming any longer. As soon as Democrats are finished using her on the January 6th Committee, they will discard her. And she trashed her relationships with Republicans a long time ago, which means she has no allies with whom to work on issues that are important to Wyomingites. When I am the next congresswoman from Wyoming, I will always be an effective advocate for our wonderful state and never forget who hired me for the job.” | | | | DONATE BY MAIL: Hageman for Wyoming P.O. #
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46929223/352361095/1401769761?refcode=AU_MLJ_EG_PET_RES_AC_20220624_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83ODAzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzYzE0NzRmMy1lYWYzLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=loOZFZHuK_wACBvMsHqokoCM5jHDc-DOVgu-JT6bdng=)

Friend,
Today, the radical, far-right majority on the Supreme Court imposed their unpopular, legally unsupported view on the American people – overturning _Roe v. Wade_ and ending the constitutional right to an abortion for millions in this country.
This is the culmination of a decades-long assault waged by the Republican Party against reproductive freedom and our democracy.
**Make no mistake: the Supreme Court’s decision will have lethal consequences for people who need live-saving abortions and, in particular, will compound cycles of poverty and marginalization for Black and brown people who’ve had their constitutional right to choose stripped away. **
This Court is on a rampage. We cannot allow the Court’s 6-3, hyper-partisan majority to continue to chip away at our fundamental rights any longer.
Congress must pass the _Judiciary Act of 2021_ , my bill with Reps. Jerry Nadler and Hank Johnson and Sen. Ed Markey to add four seats to the Supreme Court in order to restore balance and integrity to the institution.
**[In light of today’s decision, please sign our petition to tell President Biden and Congress that we MUST expand the Supreme Court and enact other judicial reforms. We cannot afford to sit back and let this Court roll back all the progress we’ve made over the past decades — because they will not stop at _Roe_.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46929224/352361096/1066052264?refcode=AU_MLJ_EG_PET_RES_AC_20220624_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83ODAzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzYzE0NzRmMy1lYWYzLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=loOZFZHuK_wACBvMsHqokoCM5jHDc-DOVgu-JT6bdng=&emci=b2d79047-def3-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=3c1474f3-eaf3-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=24719896)**

For me, this is personal. Because it is women like my single mother, who worked multiple jobs just to provide for our family – Black and brown folks, and the poorest in our society – who will suffer most from this devastating decision. That is why, long before today’s decision, I have been leading the fight against the right-wing supermajority that has broken the Court.
This decision is a partisan assault on reproductive freedom and a radical departure from 50 years of settled law. The Supreme Court’s role is to protect fundamental rights, not undermine them when they are at odds with the Justices’ personal beliefs.
Congress has changed the size of the Supreme Court seven times before in our nation’s history. Failure to expand the Court now threatens our entire way of life.
That’s not a risk worth taking.
[**We must fight for our progressive values and expand the Court. If you agree, please add your name to our petition.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46929226/352361098/1066052264?refcode=AU_MLJ_EG_PET_RES_AC_20220624_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83ODAzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzYzE0NzRmMy1lYWYzLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=loOZFZHuK_wACBvMsHqokoCM5jHDc-DOVgu-JT6bdng=&emci=b2d79047-def3-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=3c1474f3-eaf3-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=24719896)

clean_body: = Friend, Today, the radical, far-right majority on the Supreme Court imposed their unpopular, legally unsupported view on the American people – overturning Roe v. Wade and ending the constitutional right to an abortion for millions in this country. This is the culmination of a decades-long assault waged by the Republican Party against reproductive freedom and our democracy. Make no mistake: the Supreme Court’s decision will have lethal consequences for people who need live-saving abortions and, in particular, will compound cycles of poverty and marginalization for Black and brown people who’ve had their constitutional right to choose stripped away. This Court is on a rampage. We cannot allow the Court’s 6-3, hyper-partisan majority to continue to chip away at our fundamental rights any longer. Congress must pass the Judiciary Act of 2021 , my bill with Reps. Jerry Nadler and Hank Johnson and Sen. Ed Markey to add four seats to the Supreme Court in order to restore balance and integrity to the institution. For me, this is personal. Because it is women like my single mother, who worked multiple jobs just to provide for our family – Black and brown folks, and the poorest in our society – who will suffer most from this devastating decision. That is why, long before today’s decision, I have been leading the fight against the right-wing supermajority that has broken the Court. This decision is a partisan assault on reproductive freedom and a radical departure from 50 years of settled law. The Supreme Court’s role is to protect fundamental rights, not undermine them when they are at odds with the Justices’ personal beliefs. Congress has changed the size of the Supreme Court seven times before in our nation’s history. Failure to expand the Court now threatens our entire way of life. That’s not a risk worth taking. Thank you for your support. I’ll be in touch with more information when I have it. Peter,

**The Supreme Court has officially released their decision that overturns the landmark _Roe v. Wade_ case.**

This ruling is devastating and is a massive step backward for a woman's right to choose. With _Roe_ overturned, women in more than half the states in the country have lost the freedom to make the most profoundly impactful healthcare decision of their lives – when and whether to have a child.

As a doctor, I know that deeply personal reproductive decisions should be between a patient and her doctor. The Supreme Court's ruling today will not end abortion. Instead, it will delay abortion until later into pregnancy where it could cause it to be less safe. And for those forced to carry a pregnancy they did not choose, that pregnancy carries real risks to their health.

This decision won't be the end of attacks on a woman's right to choose. Senate Minority Leader Mitch McConnell says a ban that would make abortion illegal nationwide is "possible." This would mean that regardless of where in the country a person lives – from red states to blue states – abortion services are now at stake.

As the only pro-choice woman doctor in Congress, I am dedicated to defending a woman's right to choose. While today's decision is devastating, I will continue to work to ensure that we protect this fundamental right for every woman, no matter where she lives.

clean_body: We have to do everything we can to fight for our rights. Team, While we've been anticipating this for weeks, I am devastated by this ruling. As a direct result of wrongheaded, backwards ideology, decades of established law and precedent will be at risk of being overturned and if that happens, women across our country will pay the price, with low income women of color experiencing the most severe impact of the decision. These bans and attacks on abortion access fall hardest on those most vulnerable -- and will set a precedent for the highest court in our country to attack the rights of already marginalized communities across the country. No matter what, I will fight to ensure that Los Angeles is always a safe haven for reproductive freedom. But our city may be at risk. In November, I am going up against a former Republican and self-funded billionaire who has a history of supporting anti-abortion politicians. Rick Caruso has proven his values do not align with the people of our city. Representation matters, team. Women need a voice. Women need choice. Women need freedom. **Harriet Hageman statement on Supreme Court abortion ruling **
---
Harriet Hageman, Republican candidate for the U.S. House of Representatives in Wyoming, today issued the following statement regarding the U.S. Supreme Court ruling on abortion:
“This is a literal life-saving victory for millions of unborn babies, who would otherwise be snuffed out by abortion, which has already claimed the lives of tens of millions of others under Roe v. Wade. This ruling restores the proper role of the courts in these matters by correctly returning decisions regarding abortion law to the states. This is just a first step in the fight for life. There is more work to be done on behalf of the unborn, and as Wyoming’s next congresswoman, I will always vote for the right to life for the innocent unborn.
“Liz Cheney, however, has lost the ability to be an advocate for anyone, including unborn babies, since she has shredded any chance that she can effectively represent Wyoming any longer. As soon as Democrats are finished using her on the January 6th Committee, they will discard her. And she trashed her relationships with Republicans a long time ago, which means she has no allies with whom to work on issues that are important to Wyomingites. When I am the next congresswoman from Wyoming, I will always be an effective advocate for our wonderful state and never forget who hired me for the job.”

subject: It’s time we end the filibuster and codify Roe
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY WELCH FOR VERMONT
body:
There is nothing more important right now than codifying the right to abortion so that all Americans can have access to reproductive freedom no matter their zip code.

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=578%2E61531%2EF0YpQu)
Hello,
The Supreme Court just handed down their decision in Dobbs vs. Jackson. **This decision means is that the Supreme Court has overturned _Roe v. Wade_ , and ended the constitutional right to abortion.**
**Overturning _Roe_ sets this country back decades—and it will immediately put the health of millions around the country at risk.** This isn't a fluke case; this is the product of a decades-long plan led by Mitch McConnell to stack the court with anti-choice justices. We need to act right now by codifying the right to abortion to guarantee that all Americans have reproductive freedom no matter their zip code.
This decision means that for thirteen states in our country— _Arkansas, Idaho, Kentucky, Louisiana, Mississippi, Missouri, North Dakota, Oklahoma, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, and Wyoming_ —“trigger laws” have already gone into effect, automatically banning all or nearly all abortions. More will soon follow suit.
[**The stakes couldn’t be higher If you’re ready to take action, add your name to our petition right away and send a message to Congress that it’s time to codify Roe.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/signup/em-protect-right-abortion?source=em_20220624_p_p_roe&t=3&akid=578%2E61531%2EF0YpQu)
[ADD YOUR NAME ](https://act.welchforvermont.com/signup/em-protect-right-abortion?source=em_20220624_p_p_roe&t=7&t=8&akid=578%2E61531%2EF0YpQu)
---
This decision isn’t the end goal for Republicans. If they take control of Congress, they’ll try to pass a nationwide abortion ban. The stakes of this November’s elections couldn’t be higher. Let me be clear, if I’m elected to the Senate I will vote to abolish the filibuster in order to pass federal abortion protections.
**This is why I’m running for U.S. Senate—to work in the best interest of the people and to protect our constitutional rights.**
[**We can’t afford to give up. If we do, the GOP will win. So, are you with me? Add your name to tell the Senate to codify Roe right away.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/signup/em-protect-right-abortion?source=em_20220624_p_p_roe&t=4&akid=578%2E61531%2EF0YpQu)

Peter

body:
Division, political strife, and infighting have left many Americans disillusioned with Christianity and the Church.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zmbgf1t8gtbd7skkmj6nolsfji59m55ppmpkdc88_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jk5p7atdge5p78d5jmeqjetjjkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbq39c376eoe0t3jeorrac36c1hb2thn66pbcopnc9oj6cdke1indd5kclgj0pj0cv970sj2cpob4pjgsipm6o3i6pj38p5l6go75cb66aob4pj0s2qm6o70mkoj3d9hmlp238h1e8he4933clhm0p75cpi69oh5u)

---
Dear Friend, Division, political strife, and infighting have left many Americans disillusioned with Christianity and the Church. For the first time in 80 years, A recent Gallup poll found that more than 50% of Adults in the United States do not belong to _any_ church or house of worship. The number is even higher for millenials. American Christianity seems to be very good at promoting anything but the actual Gospel of Christ Jesus these days–namely, that Christ died for your sin and rose for your justification. It can feel like this anti-Gospel infection is only getting worse, as many people walk away from their faith. [**That’s why I am writing to you today and asking you to give your opinion on the state of faith in America.**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zabnavj4pas6a1smcas0d3nt9cjd7gj5gre47mp8_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1ieapj4cjh2bs)
---
[**Give Your Opinion On The State of Faith in America**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zu1q38i7h3f499fc8ll0f3e9caei9ptvu9sdgj30_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1ieapj4cjh2bs)
---
America is experiencing a crisis of hope. People are frantically looking for something certain to put their hope in as careers, political figures, and even physical health prove to be fragile. And too often, Americans are not receiving hope and certainty from the church. Instead of preaching the promises of God to their congregants, many Christian leaders are trading in the Gospel for an unbearable checklist of ways to earn God’s favor (i.e. more ‘to-dos’). To preserve the church in America and faith in God, do you believe that it is essential for people to know and proclaim the actual Gospel – that the death of Christ saves sinners? Are churches and religious organizations in your state teaching the center of the Christian Scriptures - Christ Jesus crucified and risen for sinners - or are they majoring in the minors? [**If you are concerned about the current state of faith in America, please share your opinions by completing the National Survey on the State of Faith in America today.**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zn1m7ed9bius53rt4ubc89go90h8lnn5pd2bqkro_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1ieapj4cjh2bs)

Roe v.Wade is Dead

With the Supreme Court's decision on Dobbs v. Jackson, the Supreme Court overturned 50 years of Federal abortion rights.
Millions of unborn babies have been given the gift of life!
Justice Alito, in his opinion, says that:
---
---
Federal abortion rights were never constitutional.
Now that Roe v. Wade has been overturned, each state gets to decide whether to allow the heinous act of ending the life of a precious, vulnerable human being.
I want you to know that I am unequivocally pro-life.
Science and data prove that a new life, a new body, and a new strain of DNA begins at conception.
Everyone is endowed with life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness, including the unborn.
The fight is just beginning. Now, it is time to work on making Michigan a pro-life state.
As governor, I will work with the legislature and pro-life Michiganians to implement life-affirming policies, so that women do not see abortion as their only recourse.
I will fight until we remove this scourge of abortion from the State of Michigan.
Will it be easy? No.
Pro-aborts will come after you for your pro-life beliefs. They will riot, censor, dox and otherwise threaten you.
They will rage against the dying of this evil, but they have already lost, and they know it.
We may lose some battles, but in the end, we will win the war.
God bless the unborn and God bless the brave Justices of the Supreme Court!

clean_body: | Peter, I'm horrified by what happened today. With callous disregard for the majority of Americans who believe that the right to an abortion is a personal choice and not one for the government to decide, the Supreme Court has stripped away an essential right and sent our country back 50 years. This news is devastating, and I know I'm not alone in this feeling. Millions of people in Oregon and around the country are shattered by this ruling. But the fight is far from over. I have always said that no matter what happens at the Supreme Court, reproductive rights will be protected in Oregon. As Governor, I will keep that promise. My focus will be on upholding the landmark legislation that I already passed – making sure that no matter what happens on the national stage, Oregonians have the right to choose for themselves. There's a lot at stake this November – and even more so now with this definitive ruling from the Supreme Court that overturns access to legal, safe abortion. = | = Our fight has not ended, and we are in this together. subject: re: the SCOTUS decision to overturn Roe
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Cheri Beasley for North Carolina
body:
The Supreme Court just decided to overturn Roe v. Wade.
#

The Supreme Court just ruled to overturn _Roe v. Wade_.
It is the terrifying and dangerous moment that so many of us have warned was coming, and once again, Washington is failing to protect our rights.
Too many Senators lack the courage to fight for our rights. So our only option, if we are going to codify the right to reproductive freedom for every woman in this country, is to mobilize in the most competitive races where we expand our Senate majority.
North Carolina is one of our best chances to do that, and I promise that if you help me flip this seat, I will not hesitate to be the 51st vote to end the filibuster and codify abortion rights into law.
[**If you want to see real change and progress in the U.S. Senate, please make a donation today to help us flip North Carolina and expand our majority. A 50/50 Senate is not working for our families, so it’s our job to change it.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-june22.-3KU-G&refcode=em220624-1-ma&refcode2=1031.357359.5PGxsY&t=1&akid=1031%2E357359%2E5PGxsY)

****
As former Chief Justice of the North Carolina Supreme Court, I want to be 100% clear: reproductive freedom is a constitutional right.
This decision is exactly what extreme right-wing politicians like my opponent Ted Budd fought for. Next on their list is a full federal ban on abortion. Ted Budd wants a total ban on abortion without exceptions. And it will not stop there. This decision also lays the groundwork for attacks on birth control, LGBTQ+ rights, and more from the Supreme Court.
I know this is a devastating moment. I share your anger, fear, and frustration, but I know that we cannot give in to defeat. We cannot back down. With our rights at stake, we must elect Senators who will expand our majority and protect our rights – and that is exactly the opportunity we have in North Carolina.
[**Please consider making a donation today to help us flip North Carolina. With your help, we will win this race, end the filibuster, and secure our rights — from abortion to voting rights to LGBTQ equality and beyond.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-june22.-3KU-G&refcode=em220624-1-ma&refcode2=1031.357359.5PGxsY&t=26&akid=1031%2E357359%2E5PGxsY)
Reproductive freedom is a constitutional right. It is health care. It is economic freedom. It is justice.
Thank you for standing with us in the fight.

subject: Why we need Patty Murray in this moment
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY PEOPLE FOR PATTY MURRAY
body:
“the single most effective Democratic combatant against Republican attempts to restrict abortion”
#
Peter,

Joe Biden began a war on energy from the very moment he took office. He has put American families at severe financial risk. body:
[1]Charles Booker

It’s shameful,
Peter.

This morning, the Supreme Court officially released their ruling for
Dobbs v. Jackson Women's Health Organization and dismantled the
protections we once knew under Roe v. Wade.

In their decision, they erase our constitutional right to an abortion and
undo decades of settled legal precedent. As a result, millions of
Americans will now be denied their agency, humanity, life-saving
healthcare, and reproductive freedom.

I want to make this clear: This was an extremist decision made possible by
Trump, Rand Paul, and the far-right Senators who worked to mold an
ultra-conservative majority on the Supreme Court. They all agreed that the
death of millions of women — our daughters, our mothers, our loved ones —
is not too high a cost to pay to advance their radical, dangerous, and
shameful political agenda.

This moment calls on each and every one of us to step up and help as we
respond to this historic attack on reproductive rights.

We must abolish the filibuster. We must pass the Women’s Health Protection
Act. We must keep organizing to make sure everyone has quality healthcare,
including abortion coverage. We must expand the Supreme Court. And we must
replace anti-abortion Senators like Rand Paul so we can take meaningful
action in the Senate.

The stakes of election day have never been higher.

My determination to fight this election has never been stronger. For my
daughters, for the people of Kentucky — I will not back down in this
fight.

Together, we must work for the next 137 days to make sure our movement
rises up to replace Rand Paul, expand the Senate, and ensure the votes
necessary to protect abortion access on the federal level.

We won’t stop until that happens.

In solidarity,

Charles

---
It's so heartbreaking that even writing about it is difficult for me to do. Job Price was born into a tight knit family in a small town in Pennsylvania. His loving mother and father fostered an environment where Job and his younger sister, Bronwyn, could thrive. According to his teachers, coaches, friends, and family, Job refused to accept anything but his best effort in all that he did. But was also the first to laugh at himself when that ‘best effort’ didn’t quite go as planned. Commander Price understood and embraced the importance of placing the greater good above self at the early age of 18. That’s what led him to serve our country in the military. While serving, SEAL Commander Price quickly rose through the ranks and was described as focused, disciplined, loyal, and dedicated - to name a few. He cared deeply about his country and fought to protect American ideals for his wife, his kid, and all of us. Tragically, while deployed in Afghanistan, Commander Price was found dead on the morning of December 22, 2012, with a pistol in his hand and a pool of blood underneath him. Commander Price showed immense love to all of those he was close to in his life and was always honest with them. That's why when his sudden death got pronounced a suicide by a Navy death review board, his family knew something wasn't right.
---
[**HELP THEM GET THE TRUTH**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=c22af4bf523a4f5ab6bab1f5cc1a1f07&_e=nWJyfpvLBFtO4ocCHAUpKKbpDcUXnToLM30UJKIYqTMkfknOdNU-FdOpWd7gxxLucapgVrJu9fNcexybNvils_4DYgygLkhcij51L8TdV_ax6PHRgp3rifBwhRgciu98kv6BlLRJb4GuoUdArTn7EtvOHwDwz_FJ1whi0Pywir7cw14tqBNYsdSGFftcf2M-LwQXYcZ-TkbK1ebSyvVNHwfyS4KKuk3UjMTkMY5prqRo9s1AD_NjPWMIw070fVfiBnJFr6vsO4iY4lOCwiDqZI-xXppv3lUUPe3xCR4LKrpDMVasniUwq_2Y0wxZVz1Zz2l-3YVJnsV49WdCzAtWGazF2Mk2UuA7qo5t7Be6XmwULQHR1HiaLE62t_S-J7zxHusDT3d953fN5-8L2mV_Ntz4PwM9pyBQ70WwRhtlj6uyR-33rfhmzrORO2XYsU3rB_GqzbTiKbHNkhSLA9yQlropgyWox90k8WKuZ_huFVI5ldkvxLpLXcC2vEfP5zH8AO9hOgXfbEIEV1gY0aS6PQ%3D%3D)
---
One of his former SEAL team members called the board, asking them to consider the possibility of murder and others began pointing out issues in the investigation. **But, to this day, Commander Price's family and friends are still forced to live through the uncertainty that looms around his death. The military refuses to share documents regarding his passing or address the family's concerns about the mishandling of forensic evidence.** UAP is trying to get his family answers. But we need your help to do it.
---
[**DONATE NOW**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=c22af4bf523a4f5ab6bab1f5cc1a1f07&_e=nWJyfpvLBFtO4ocCHAUpKKbpDcUXnToLM30UJKIYqTMkfknOdNU-FdOpWd7gxxLucapgVrJu9fNcexybNvils_4DYgygLkhcij51L8TdV_ax6PHRgp3rifBwhRgciu98kv6BlLRJb4GuoUdArTn7EtvOHwDwz_FJ1whi0Pywir7cw14tqBNYsdSGFftcf2M-LwQXYcZ-TkbK1ebSyvVNHwfyS4KKuk3UjMTkMY5prqRo9s1AD_NjPWMIw070fVfiBnJFr6vsO4iY4lOCwiDqZI-xXppv3lUUPe3xCR4LKrpDMVasniUwq_2Y0wxZVz1Zj2CDbjVtXXVP0WwIIPuNFbRRFFGAUbOM_t-4RcLHRb3NYaO66EsvjflX0uXTNaus2l0pBebIkybx8rrJgwiKTqeM5jieMD2UOxeuyaIX1iyKCi_86FVI2vYH--_dKfRQaidFU4Nq9YYrdf4a4nLD0Fl8MJ9vhamoqRywenBr-87ORyG4JMBHzupgbn0R5WC8hkw78UOiceJg0mnnA7MiAQ%3D%3D)

---
Dear Friend, Division, political strife, and infighting have left many Americans disillusioned with Christianity and the Church. For the first time in 80 years, A recent Gallup poll found that more than 50% of Adults in the United States do not belong to _any_ church or house of worship. The number is even higher for millenials. American Christianity seems to be very good at promoting anything but the actual Gospel of Christ Jesus these days–namely, that Christ died for your sin and rose for your justification. It can feel like this anti-Gospel infection is only getting worse, as many people walk away from their faith. [**That’s why I am writing to you today and asking you to give your opinion on the state of faith in America.**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zb429h61811tjdfa9us3ekft02it00cl70tcol58_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1ieeoj2cjh2bs)
---
[**Give Your Opinion On The State of Faith in America**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zdlgqqmsdohnm84dsf02njqv5vua62q70opkbo80_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1ieeoj2cjh2bs)
---
America is experiencing a crisis of hope. People are frantically looking for something certain to put their hope in as careers, political figures, and even physical health prove to be fragile. And too often, Americans are not receiving hope and certainty from the church. Instead of preaching the promises of God to their congregants, many Christian leaders are trading in the Gospel for an unbearable checklist of ways to earn God’s favor (i.e. more ‘to-dos’). To preserve the church in America and faith in God, do you believe that it is essential for people to know and proclaim the actual Gospel – that the death of Christ saves sinners? Are churches and religious organizations in your state teaching the center of the Christian Scriptures - Christ Jesus crucified and risen for sinners - or are they majoring in the minors? [**If you are concerned about the current state of faith in America, please share your opinions by completing the National Survey on the State of Faith in America today.**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zgj0v1pvnnlu6kj9vmjtkguq45uo1ri2oltgucmo_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1ieeoj2cjh2bs)

name: Cecile Richards
subject: The end of Roe v. Wade
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Beto for Texas
body:
[1]Beto O'Rourke

The Supreme Court just overturned Roe v. Wade and stripped 36 million
women of the freedom to make their own decisions about their own bodies,
health care, and future. Now it’s up to all of us to immediately fight
back.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220624-1.sr6Dqv&refcode=ema20220624-192419&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=192419%2E444211%2EkdXeE- ]If you’re in this fight with Beto and me, will you donate now to help
defeat Greg Abbott and elect a governor in Texas who will guarantee the
right to choose?

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220624-1.sr6Dqv&refcode=ema20220624-192419&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=192419%2E444211%2EkdXeE- ]Fight Back: Donate Now

For the past half-century, this was the promise to women in the United
States:

We had the right to decide when and whether to become mothers.

We could finish school, move up in a career, and have a family when we
were ready — a right that women have around the world.

We could follow our dreams wherever they led us. And we had the freedom to
make our own decisions about our own bodies, our own health care, and our
own futures.

But six justices on the Supreme Court have taken this all away. With one
decision, the government and politicians will make the most personal
decisions about our bodies and pregnancies.

This generation will be the first one in 50 years that has lost the right
to determine their own futures.

I’ll be honest: My
generation wasn’t cynical enough to fully comprehend the extent of the
Republican Party’s willingness to trade away people’s lives for political
power and control — with Greg Abbott at the forefront. He not only fought
for but signed a law that bans abortion outright without any exception for
rape or incest. He did that, and it will go into effect in a matter of
weeks.

But it is important to know that this fight does not end once abortion is
criminalized. Republican politicians are already threatening to outlaw
forms of birth control, like IUDs. They will continue to attack us until
we win political power.

As a mom, I’m angry that my kids and others of this next generation will
live in a world filled with this fear, a world in which they do not have
the right to control their own body.

It is on all of us to stand up and fight back because there IS something
we can do right now.

Gaining political power is the only way to meet this challenge — and if
the Supreme Court is going to leave it up to the states to decide who has
control over a woman’s body, then we MUST elect a governor in Texas who
believes in a woman’s right to choose. There’s no other option.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220624-1.sr6Dqv&refcode=ema20220624-192419&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=192419%2E444211%2EkdXeE- ]Please, as a proud
part of Beto’s campaign for governor, I’m asking you to donate anything
you can to help us defeat Greg Abbott. Texas needs us to win.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220624-1.sr6Dqv&refcode=ema20220624-192419&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=192419%2E444211%2EkdXeE- ]Contribute $3

It will take unprecedented political activism to restore what is
rightfully ours: the ability to make our own decisions about our bodies.

I am in this fight. Beto is in this fight. I hope you are in this fight,
too. It will not be easy, but it is a fight we can and must win.

Let’s get to work,

Cecile

Cecile Richards
National Finance Chair, Beto for Texas
Former President of Planned Parenthood

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. Friends: I know I share in the devastation Marylanders and Americans across this nation are feeling following **the U.S. Supreme Court's decision to overturn _Roe v. Wade_ , undoing 50 years of legal precedent.** That means the right to safe, legal abortion access is no longer guaranteed at the federal level in this country, leaving states like Mississippi free to decide the fate of abortion. With a cruel pen stroke, this Supreme Court just endangered the lives of millions of women, stole the right to health care away from millions of Americans, and handed control over their bodies to the government. _Tomorrow, millions of women will wake up in an America where they do not have control over their own bodies._ **This disgraceful decision by the Court means that governors have never been more important, because now, the right to abortion will vary on a state-by-state basis.** **If we are elected Governor and Lieutenant Governor of Maryland, we will make Maryland a safe haven for abortion access.**
* We will ensure abortion providers have the funding and the training they need to deliver vital health care services.

* We will ensure the safety of women, abortion providers, and clinics. And ensure they are protected against harassment, threats, or acts of physical violence.

* We will work to enshrine abortion rights into Maryland’s constitution.

_We will do _everything_ in our power to make Maryland a safe haven for abortion access._ **[If you're able, please make a contribution to the Baltimore Abortion Fund.
