body:
But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation. Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zb19t7mjcrhc57g4425ovbt66dp17qclfus6o4qo_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkgqracjkmoq37c9l6cqj7djl6eqjetjjkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbqn7ddjegqecp9lcup38sphmoo74t9georr9djkspi30p3heuorct5imcqj4phgcv970sj2cpob4pjgsipm6o3i6pj38p5l6krr5cj66lgb4pj0s2qm6o70mkoj3d9hmlp238h1e8he4933clhm0p77c9h62oh5u)
[](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zobqjhjiur9e6h8432ridmg014qpppha5hn0ihog_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1ieeoj2c5h2bs)

Friend,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z51g6bvv8hqeg4e5tek0ad03jmpi1ncp9tge7550_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1ieeoj2c5h2bs)

**_Now I 'll share my story_... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I've dealt with racism... _**I 've even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Friend, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $10, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zkk8karoev61bijc1vj18mblra19ft2g067rdts8_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1ieeoj2c5h2bs)

I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I 'm not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zafh2qcmjnj5n14n18oqkn6q6kdfpetbvcuih8k0_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1ieeoj2c5h2bs)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z90mj79ls0d8vd07ht89grvjhovvc4fa5tvsduno_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1ieeoj2c5h2bs)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zrehggt4hovupcnsh72sg0o0rr0baf8tq6hqdjdo_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1ieeoj2c5h2bs)

* **Teaching History: **Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zir02k38qhmmhu2suo112uiqni96vqa8mbknm2ug_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1ieeoj2c5h2bs)

* **Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore.

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. [_**Please support BLEXIT 's events and help us spread our message by donating here >>>**_](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zttipco706aoqiinq8p5q84ulsfugtaqhfdiqjc8_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1ieeoj2c5h2bs)

What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor.

This is personal to me.

I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot.

Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today:

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zhsa8fiqge3mjpbdjsdubquq1v1kqc02af31cd7o_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1ieeoj2c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z8frvjo52ne9hab8lnt4816qd245gs959jda2mb0_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1ieeoj2c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $50 >>>**_](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z3aisu3qklb4sa6dvarmfprlufb52i9sisasojsg_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1ieeoj2c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zajulroshhmjddi46atvhhuv7ihhluq0n6tq0jh0_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1ieeoj2c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zsk8ukrgkgoho534isrbde4vnf9puuesiitnu0k8_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1ieeoj2c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zdj42j9phq4t1q4md3pvp34sfe23d3mknlojegt0_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1ieeoj2c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zsi3q7ogt8ef6kr0cus0scm3035cspdtsiba86fg_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1ieeoj2c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zcc7gmqg59vopruc1st9avvi5piijugo15e8frrg_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1ieeoj2c5h2bs)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z23eagr7u2n27q6cmn5fmcmmj5n6j0ei0ij7qud8_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1ieeoj2c5h2bs)

This is my last message to you before you close this email.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in faith, family, and freedom. At the end of the day, our message to urban communities is about love and empowerment.

My burning desire is to use my voice and change the direction of our urban communities and the country. The BLEXIT Foundation has a real impact, and I am inviting you to join our cause.

[_**Please consider making the most generous donation you can today by clicking here.**_](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zs4dg2lb3su4eahbbpf56petajrb9hm44piosak8_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1ieeoj2c5h2bs)

Thank you, Friend.

Candace Owens
President
BLEXIT Foundation

But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message. Entrepreneurship: I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire. BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. Teaching History: Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message. The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore. The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor. This is personal to me. I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot. Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today: This is my last message to you before you close this email. The BLEXIT Foundation believes in faith, family, and freedom. At the end of the day, our message to urban communities is about love and empowerment. My burning desire is to use my voice and change the direction of our urban communities and the country. The BLEXIT Foundation has a real impact, and I am inviting you to join our cause. Thank you, Friend. Candace Owens President BLEXIT Foundation If dpwillis67@gmail.com should not be subscribed or if you need to change your subscription information for American Defense News, . 625 First Street #183, Alexandria, VA 22314

---
Friend -- As you may have watched yesterday, I led a hearing of the 1/6 Committee focused on the incredible lengths then-President Trump went to to corrupt the DOJ into endorsing his false claims that the election was stolen. Thankfully, that effort failed. But had the top officials at DOJ been less honorable, had they not threatened to resign en masse, they could have easily provided the cover the President and his Congressional allies needed to delay certification of the election. It would have been the first constitutional crisis since our nation's founding. [](https://www.country1st.com/trump_pressured_doj_to_back_false_election_fraud_claims?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=hearing_5_16_digest_nd&n=2) | [](https://www.country1st.com/trump_pressured_doj_to_back_false_election_fraud_claims?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=hearing_5_16_digest_nd&n=3 "Watch: Kinzinger Interviewed After Leading 1/6

Hearing") [Watch: Kinzinger Interviewed After Leading 1/6 Hearing](https://www.country1st.com/trump_pressured_doj_to_back_false_election_fraud_claims?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=hearing_5_16_digest_nd&n=3)
---
Yesterday's hearing also made it clear that the DOJ followed every lead the President threw at them -- even some of the most far fetched conspiracy theories. It wasn't that the DOJ refused to investigate these claims, as the President repeatedly stated, it was that none of them were found to be true. Trump and his allies were told this day after day -- yet they persisted.
At one point, the President is recorded to have begged: "Just say the election was corrupt and leave the rest to me and the Republican congressmen."
January 6th happened because the facts were irrelevant to President Trump. He cared only about protecting his very real power and very fragile ego. He was willing to sacrifice our republic to prolong his presidency. I can imagine no more dishonorable act by a President
My greatest concern at this moment is that our nation hasn't done enough to prevent this from happening again. I will be following up this weekend to layout just what our movement can do to help hold the line and preserve our republic.
Country First,
Adam

## 1/6 Committee Digest
Country First presents the next edition of The Digest to highlight the important work of the 1/6 Committee. Our aim is to make this available to our members within 24 hours after each hearing. **MARK YOUR CALENDARS FOR THE NEXT HEARING:** **TENTATIVELY TUESDAY, JULY 12** **In Case You Missed It:**
* Rep. Kinzinger [speaks](https://www.country1st.com/trump_pressured_doj_to_back_false_election_fraud_claims?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=hearing_5_16_digest_nd&n=4) to CNN's Jake Tapper directly following the Thursday's hearing.
* Rep. Kinzinger’s [compelling](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=GQ96LxW7tJscudkL8mlwNzVEKXk7dMDJzwJlfbbiiRaPrSy7vWJFHk-TRTyBTyzn&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=hearing_5_16_digest_nd&n=5) closing remarks.

**Who Gave Testimony on Wednesday:**
* **Brad Raffensberger** , Georgia Secretary of State
* **Gabe Sterling** , Georgia Deputy Secretary of State
* **Rusty Bowers** , Arizona House of Representatives Speaker
* **Wandrea "Shaye" Moss** , Election worker in Atlanta in 2020

**Who Gave Testimony Thursday**
* **Jeffrey Rosen** , Former Acting Attorney General
* **Richard Donoghue** , Former Acting Deputy Attorney General
* **Steve Engel** , Former Assistant Attorney General

* * *
Here are the major developments from the committee: **Kinzinger’s Remarks, A Stark Warning to the American People** Congressman Adam Kinzinger, one of two Republicans serving on the 1/6 Committee, led the fifth public hearing Thursday, [sharing](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=HkTArpYoFmU_GhK8KgLuiJ5mtPYK2XVZDbwix_EznrAZA9Pd_-FXzAF6J9si_l8KJPCDyEUTtI0b2z-qtUgpjh5uKiaJddvp823lHNMijrvIa8gAcCYqhdE2nwCfkDPXDB4bs04r9r5fbKLs86HYKNpJjvB3mVsZZW75OA9dqp4&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=hearing_5_16_digest_nd&n=6) his fears for the future of the nation. In opening remarks, the Air Force pilot spoke directly to his Republican colleagues, urging them to face the facts and think about the consequences of their actions. "I want to take a moment now to speak directly to my fellow Republicans, imagine the country’s top prosecutor, with the power to open investigations, subpoena, charge crimes and seek imprisonment, imagine that official pursuing the agenda of the other party instead of that of the American people as a whole. If you’re a Democrat, imagine it the other way around." Kinzinger, a decade-long Congressman, focused on the former President's high pressure campaign to make the DOJ bend to his will. Kinzinger outlined late-night meetings, cryptic text messages, and stunning revelations surrounding the Attorney General and the Department of Justice’s refusal to break their oaths as the former President pressured them to knowingly do so. As Congressman Kinzinger said Thursday, and on January 6, 2021 on the House floor following the violent coup attempt: "The bottom line: If we ask men and women to be willing to give their lives for this nation, and we talk about their service with tears in our eyes, shouldn’t we be willing to give up our jobs to uphold the Constitution?" **Former Deputy Attorney General Richard Donoghue describes conversations with election lie proponent Jeffery Clark** Testifying at the fifth 1/6 hearing, Richard Donoghue, the former acting Deputy Attorney General, recalls combatting Jeffery Clark’s off-grid investigations into the baseless election claims advanced by the former President. Clark, the former Assistant Attorney General for the Environment and Natural Resources Division, was approached by Donoghue and former Acting Attorney General Jeffery Rosen. They made it clear to Clark that "to suggest or dictate to state legislatures how they should select their electors" was not the DOJ’s role, nor was it even remotely appropriate. However, Donoghue and Rosen’s attempts to quell Clark's conduct were unsuccessful, and Clark continued to conduct investigations into dubious claims of voter fraud. Seeing this, Donoghue confronted Clark again, asserting that his conduct constituted "nothing less than the Justice Department meddling in an election," to which Clark responded, "I think a lot of people have meddled in this election." **Former President Told DOJ Officials to Lie** Then-President of the United States, Donald Trump, told his Department of Justice, often called the "people’s lawyer," to say that the election was corrupt, when the same Department of Justice had advised him this was an outright lie. In [compelling](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=Y1JQzDDPf_G40AL8Qe48611rYQ0a0vCbGOwV8UfOexKNDXdE4OOh7eYXyX78RjzzIg6_Wrlb8w5EMd0LJmFwgg32mge5YeRjJcNMGNrBtNs-WsQEOSlQYgtY-8N9_nYGnagijGwUNFoTy03KjqlQ53D6PWJwTPdFH5W8sqRWFH0&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=hearing_5_16_digest_nd&n=7) testimony given by former Acting Deputy Attorney General Richard Donoghue, Mr. Donoghue recalled a December 27th meeting where Trump was growing more frantic, even [asking](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=6NS2bKpYnMmDAAaH_sla5-OnI6prbmo76HcEi7dl7vPwt8cuvqTHu9SqagbnCijgFmfP29ZNPv7_9qH6NFwuCO-1SGJJ0pDd60ridPe6fqMU_6poxh4bQKgVBBqGwKm3rc7eEPk1HQ5Ey2123o2TzKV6cY7KH1oDKLgB-S0PUYictvjStRxmJDs593JyOOQu8nc3VybRGTm_bSy5G5QTBg&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=hearing_5_16_digest_nd&n=8) for the DOJ to seize voting machines. "He responded very quickly, and said, essentially, 'That’s not what I’m asking you to do, what I’m asking you to do is just say it was corrupt and leave the rest up to me and the Republican congressmen'," Donoghue recalled Trump telling top DOJ officials in the meeting. The former President called a meeting to discuss options for overturning the legitimate election results of the 2020 election. Despite pressure from the former President inside the Oval Office, the nation’s top lawyers remained steadfast in their oath, opposing the President and threatening to step down. "He had this arsenal of allegations that he wanted to rely on," said Donoghue, "these allegations were simply not true." **Giuliani and other Trump henchmen wanted the Justice Department to be led by someone not worried about a 'reputation'** In his private testimony to the committee, Rudy Giuliani, the now-suspended attorney formerly serving as Trump’s personal lawyer, mentioned that he suggested finding a new Attorney General who was not worried about his reputation. He and other Trump allies attempted to aggrandize former Assistant Attorney General for the Environment and Natural Resources Division Jeffery Clark to run the Justice Department. As former Acting Deputy Attorney General Richard Donoghue and former Acting Attorney General Jeffrey Rosen testified at the fifth 1/6 Committee hearing on Thursday, the attempt to elevate Jeffery Clark by Trump's underbosses evolved into a secret meeting with Clark and the former President. This meeting broke the long-standing precedent that contact between the White House and the Justice Department be largely limited to higher-ranking senior officials, a status not held by Clark. Along with Donoghue and Rosen, Steven Engel, the former Assistant Attorney General, expressed the concerns about such a meeting, stating that the precedent Clark and Trump defied was intended to ensure investigations are "free from either the reality or any appearance of political interference." **Top DOJ Officials Call Trump’s Plan a "Murder-Suicide Pact"** In stunning new testimony given by top DOJ officials inside a packed committee hearing room, the once former-President’s allies, revealed the [intricate](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=Y5Xlf9pA_AJcYmYaz2zF4ONKe1XvI6k8E853rUwXybSVyvikem1nYk0cRn0uqepMb79I_eIYpJY3cw70FWs-G-dlXl0mgfCF6VlTu6ZXYEo&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=hearing_5_16_digest_nd&n=9) plan to overturn the election. The plan included installing an unqualified environmental lawyer, Jeffrey Clark, as the Attorney General of the United States. From there, Clark, under the direction of Trump, planned to send a drafted letter to state officials, alleging voter fraud. Donoghue said he told Clark, "You're an environmental lawyer. How about you go back to your office, and we'll call you when there's an oil spill." "I said, good f--cking — excuse me, sorry, f'ing a-hole, congratulations, you just admitted your first step or act you would take as Attorney General would be committing a felony and violating Rule 6(e)," former White House lawyer, Eric Herschmann, recalled in his taped deposition. **Sitting Members of Congress Begged for a Pardon After January 6 Insurrection** Republican members of Congress asked for pardons from the former President in the days and weeks following the deadly attack on the Capitol. Cassidy Hutchinson, former aide to then-White House Chief of Staff Mark Meadows, [recalled](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=HVBK5x9dnBx-ujVjYaP8mYb8lfuh9xzrz1uEAGNXGUkUCFUV4MSFXMK-7OVetwAyjfgHN2EKgfmCfTEaD82htmgt3rNHxTbVaqxpaELffvK4KJaxU0etIevS6EoDAv2rwnM6pdBntzYMWVlsApEZIQ&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=hearing_5_16_digest_nd&n=10) Mo Brooks (R-AL), Matt Gaetz (R-FL), Andy Biggs (R-AZ), Louie Gohmert (R-TX), and Scott Perry (R-PA) asking the former President and his staff for pardons due to their involvement in the events leading up to the attack on January 6th. Perry’s text messages to Mark Meadows were also [revealed](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=lMhWMbT_phq2h70nHuJj634NPgIdcZCgOWaVe5OseRiFwF6MXNBfEh3z46CymgHau8mVV5cKsyrb9SzJxbSB0dMkQlRdArvfXFTAlrONrgnytFJ0vqjn09SQkJhQ-mpsKUOcbeM3MN5itaW0u9p2BeAR7Sownq8gv6hr1G5K_WwkbR7edG4RIKzOmzVNl8E3LP9-Zm3Upjdm0HAauKU36g&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=hearing_5_16_digest_nd&n=11), where he pushed for an unqualified DOJ lawyer sympathetic to the President's fraud claims to be elevated to Attorney General. Hutchinson, in video testimony shown today, focused in on Gaetz, saying the conspiracy theory-peddling member from Florida was personally asking for a pardon as early as December. Congressman Brooks acknowledged that he did ask for a pardon. The other members, except for Gaetz, who refused to comment, [denied](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=_iXnL0bCffDuT3k_fuMSrAxQP2mNVEEdVtSFtRVqVfmpjDhdqhjhNTyUOEqg0nMWdbHTeJSqQ7QHmi4duWyYB236pXgkx4iQ6eQ3f6qRqhNo1Cf2KAxnB-p09_oes6KdnCJtLFF1SdvfuYzOQEr9Vg&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=hearing_5_16_digest_nd&n=12) asking for or inquiring about a presidential pardon. "The only reason I know to ask for a pardon is because you think you’ve committed a crime," [noted](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=GmrkqIvTVM5Gw19P8OEWnqPAtIHhAMxU89vlTUXNYDYQmyt3fftOoEcuxYqeCeVLKXviPSaAgdnAamJ5pxmrB8omDAnZYtjMvJQsPSH35FjReJ-KKw3ihuFmTiY4Uve4YYpn4MRCO1FoEnLIHfuj9A&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=hearing_5_16_digest_nd&n=13) Congressman Adam Kinzinger. **Giuliani: "We’ve got lots of theories. We just don’t have the evidence."** Rusty Bowers, the [Republican](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=PiInCVHjZg_Lhb0RQ-dhd3nupceIa8DuTdOzvpYk6G1fDuJp7AGmncy8H6LXKbps5Zenq2n8wU1zMtqzkme4VA&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=hearing_5_16_digest_nd&n=14) speaker of Arizona’s House of Representatives, stated he resisted pressure from Trump and his lieutenants to [overturn](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=OwehQGnYjrzpIc0rxaR28TjNeSwdMifb5N5uHnLWInlEXIStXm-z3Ep7t23Rjp3mi7Dy7qvOS72X4Eid7zTrXD1XfF0T8KNu4fGmCu9u4uo-mZxtekFuG33ByjlZaWE5-a7QizHmptwfeAB8kAzQ9A&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=hearing_5_16_digest_nd&n=15) Trump’s loss in the state. "I didn’t want to be used as a pawn.” He told the panel that he had refused attempts from Trump and his legal advisers who said they had evidence of fraud sufficient to reverse the election outcome yet never produced any. The committee [focused](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=oGkNRIpNU-65tzHrfmdwr1v_zeIcytTKZvoQ54gLwJqOx8C7LZerg-5Q2mpzTLXrgVMYZXr0i1uf-nbyaX4a17QmIUoP9yMqmyvIV6Jrfl_1gADoR6VzMqUWOTKgI4SH&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=hearing_5_16_digest_nd&n=16) on the fact that Mr. Trump and his lawyers knew they didn’t have evidence of widespread election fraud. Mr. Bowers testified that Trump lawyer Giuliani admitted he had not uncovered evidence of widespread fraud. Bowers recalled Giuliani saying: "We’ve got lots of theories. We just don’t have the evidence." Mr. Bowers questioned the legality of participating in such a scheme, to which he testified Mr. Eastman responded: "Just do it and let the courts work it out." The panel played a video showing Mr. Trump’s lawyers, including Mr. Giuliani, Mr. Eastman, and Cleta Mitchell, as they worked to overturn the election. Mr. Giuliani held hearings and made calls to Republican lawmakers around the country. The scheme to use fake electors is the subject of a Justice Department investigation. **Compelling Testimony Given by Georgia Election Workers** Wandrea "Shaye" Moss and her mother Ruby Freeman were Georgia election workers for the 2020 election. They gave testimony on Tuesday discussing how former President Trump and his lawyer Rudy Giuliani [targeted](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=GmrkqIvTVM5Gw19P8OEWnqPAtIHhAMxU89vlTUXNYDa4Aww-1hakS1pov0ZVCRdOlFgTlktnd83jJMn_c71K6VT-x8Wjl7Y1iiBi0V3vBdb0YY6BihLOJe_0Lo6-OD08kvOcGWj-ONj93FIe7kxIaV7RWYXHWKyMGE8LtLN2Mbw&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=hearing_5_16_digest_nd&n=17) the mother daughter pair claiming they had engaged in fraudulent behavior in order to overturn the election results. Video evidence of Moss and Freeman moving a box of regular ballots and passing a mint between one another had been twisted by conspiracy theorists and Trump supporters into evidence of a suitcase containing false ballots and USB drives containing heroin or cocaine. This footage was then used by Guliani to target Moss and Freedman, labeling them as responsible for rigging the election in favor of Biden. **Death Threats, Racist Insults, and More Thrown at Election Workers for Simply Doing Their Job** The former President referred to Ruby Freeman as a “hustler,” claiming that she was a [“professional vote scammer.”](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=9j2xrPCwd3yFLU_EZoBgHqr48A9MgrjGgtL5hqC0X7vMZt1724scd3egHYKB9ZAsmDsTsO3VUmrygw422WoTvwGIsbyoKEV8G7uDyxYeNjtl8FNHd9MyVqxh6hyIdTYw&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=hearing_5_16_digest_nd&n=18) Freeman and her daughter were villainized by Trump supporters, received threats, and no longer felt comfortable going by their given names or being out in public. Ms. Freeman, an entrepreneur and beloved member of the community, was threatened into a reclusion because of the lies and actions of former President Trump and his allies. Shaye Moss, Freeman’s daughter, testified before the 1/6 Committee that in the wake of the hateful and racist threats and the false accusations that she gained sixty pounds, second-guesses all of her actions, and doesn’t feel safe anywhere. "It’s turned my life upside down," Moss [testified](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=oGkNRIpNU-65tzHrfmdwr8ctCBEQN1kS-Wc9yfFTOKzcNInafkhSV-Y_e7mSwEMkk6ScLBanAKGVlnPtrREBFsiyxRZ7kMhD0E7OISK1ieH1KXCb0R3C7uPcLdX2q8AxC81FiwMNn38J-4WjAgKbtV_4tSe8rA2CSg24cSaNzKM&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=hearing_5_16_digest_nd&n=19) through tears and a shaky voice. Freeman voiced a similar experience saying that she has lost her name and reputation because Giuliani decided to use her and her daughter as a scapegoat. Freeman also testified that she was unable to leave her home for the two months following the election after FBI officials warned that leaving would jeopardize her safety. "Donald Trump didn’t care about the threats of violence. He did not condemn them, he made no effort to stop them; he went forward with his fake allegations anyway," Rep. Cheney said. Moss's mother, Ms. Freeman, who also worked the polls in Georgia during the 2020 election, expressed her disbelief with the former President’s conduct following his defeat to Joe Biden: "The president of the United States is supposed to represent everyone, not to target one. But, he targeted me." **Georgia Officials Detail Former President’s Pressure Campaign** Georgia Secretary of State, Brad Raffensperger, outlined the call heard around the world. In the days following the election, the former President [called](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=EgoLP66qKbjSe1ZxerGwBPHZI-r3be2xvbUf4_6aLHkzJOagNWhCwZwAW_SIqk3BBIQVeWnceCfYqx8you00l7u1pTkFnyJbJE34x7dGbFw&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=hearing_5_16_digest_nd&n=20) Raffensperger, begging and demanding that he find 11,000 votes from Trump. Despite the intense pressure by the former President and his team, Raffensperger resisted the demands and testified that the 2020 election in Georgia was fair and free. Because of his refusal to harvest non-existent votes, Raffensperger and his family were [targeted](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=zKtC9Hj7q1-U6T8El2-JiW_K8LDCiAh38gkiFezTh9h0DlEyIJhNfinGRSPE9n5CuTTtYes1tZ3w-GL_JJHzEYt-U1u5WpPYqBUzL-DD1ZPGccT6Vlzl74BuUnec4rykRJ-F0CBnyONSlM1f2pOmRDc6cvVp2dlQmhFCVQy37yWRnniH243f_f1CqdeY3l1_&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=hearing_5_16_digest_nd&n=21). Raffensperger testified: "And my wife started getting texts. They were typically sexualized texts which were disgusting," Raffensperger told the committee. "They started going after her to get to me – why don’t you quit and just walk away. So that happened. And then some people broke into my daughter-in-law’s home," he said. **Georgia Official "Lost It" After Seeing Death Threats Coming From Trump Supporters** In testimony [given](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=9j2xrPCwd3yFLU_EZoBgHlxOww_eP95bxQBYEjn713xzghaKfaUs_aeMl5YcteIt-IN0gQXpC7PY8NV5snW2Uzfl2BTHacReqqngd4Op9rXWkjC71dX-OnFG53VHwIDEAoToJVW2lGAdzp9HKF2siQ&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=hearing_5_16_digest_nd&n=22) on Tuesday, the Deputy Secretary of State, Gabe Sterling, recalled the infamous press conference he gave in December of 2020. After seeing death threats, racist remarks, and threats of violence, Mr. Sterling, a Republican himself, looked into the TV cameras and directed his anger towards Trump and his team. He said he lost it after seeing a contracted election worker's name on Twitter with an image of a noose, with the text indicating treason had been committed and execution was warranted. "It was the 'straw that broke the camel's back.' The young man's name, a very unique name, first generation American I believe. It said his name, 'You committed treason, may god have mercy on your soul,' with a slowly twisting GIF of a noose. And for lack of a better word I lost it." In the press conference, Sterling said: "Mr. President, it looks like you likely lost the state of Georgia. We are investigating. There is always the possibility. I get it. You have the rights to go to the courts. What you don't have the ability to do, and you need to step up and say this, is stop inspiring people to commit potential acts of violence. Someone's going to get hurt, someone's going to get shot, someone's going to get killed. Thankfully, that effort failed. But had the top officials at DOJ been less honorable, had they not threatened to resign en masse, they could have easily provided the cover the President and his Congressional allies needed to delay certification of the election. It would have been the first constitutional crisis since our nation's founding. | "Watch: Kinzinger Interviewed After Leading 1/6 Hearing" Yesterday's hearing also made it clear that the DOJ followed every lead the President threw at them -- even some of the most far fetched conspiracy theories. It wasn't that the DOJ refused to investigate these claims, as the President repeatedly stated, it was that none of them were found to be true. Trump and his allies were told this day after day -- yet they persisted. At one point, the President is recorded to have begged: "Just say the election was corrupt and leave the rest to me and the Republican congressmen." January 6th happened because the facts were irrelevant to President Trump. He cared only about protecting his very real power and very fragile ego. He was willing to sacrifice our republic to prolong his presidency. I can imagine no more dishonorable act by a President My greatest concern at this moment is that our nation hasn't done enough to prevent this from happening again. I will be following up this weekend to layout just what our movement can do to help hold the line and preserve our republic. Country First, Adam 1/6 Committee Digest Country First presents the next edition of The Digest to highlight the important work of the 1/6 Committee. Our aim is to make this available to our members within 24 hours after each hearing. MARK YOUR CALENDARS FOR THE NEXT HEARING: TENTATIVELY TUESDAY, JULY 12 In Case You Missed It: Rep. Kinzinger to CNN's Jake Tapper directly following the Thursday's hearing. Rep. Kinzinger’s closing remarks. Who Gave Testimony on Wednesday: Brad Raffensberger , Georgia Secretary of State Gabe Sterling , Georgia Deputy Secretary of State Rusty Bowers , Arizona House of Representatives Speaker Wandrea "Shaye" Moss , Election worker in Atlanta in 2020 Who Gave Testimony Thursday Jeffrey Rosen , Former Acting Attorney General Richard Donoghue , Former Acting Deputy Attorney General Steve Engel , Former Assistant Attorney General Here are the major developments from the committee: Kinzinger’s Remarks, A Stark Warning to the American People Congressman Adam Kinzinger, one of two Republicans serving on the 1/6 Committee, led the fifth public hearing Thursday, his fears for the future of the nation. In opening remarks, the Air Force pilot spoke directly to his Republican colleagues, urging them to face the facts and think about the consequences of their actions. "I want to take a moment now to speak directly to my fellow Republicans, imagine the country’s top prosecutor, with the power to open investigations, subpoena, charge crimes and seek imprisonment, imagine that official pursuing the agenda of the other party instead of that of the American people as a whole. If you’re a Democrat, imagine it the other way around." Kinzinger, a decade-long Congressman, focused on the former President's high pressure campaign to make the DOJ bend to his will. Kinzinger outlined late-night meetings, cryptic text messages, and stunning revelations surrounding the Attorney General and the Department of Justice’s refusal to break their oaths as the former President pressured them to knowingly do so. As Congressman Kinzinger said Thursday, and on January 6, 2021 on the House floor following the violent coup attempt: "The bottom line: If we ask men and women to be willing to give their lives for this nation, and we talk about their service with tears in our eyes, shouldn’t we be willing to give up our jobs to uphold the Constitution?" Former Deputy Attorney General Richard Donoghue describes conversations with election lie proponent Jeffery Clark Testifying at the fifth 1/6 hearing, Richard Donoghue, the former acting Deputy Attorney General, recalls combatting Jeffery Clark’s off-grid investigations into the baseless election claims advanced by the former President. Clark, the former Assistant Attorney General for the Environment and Natural Resources Division, was approached by Donoghue and former Acting Attorney General Jeffery Rosen. They made it clear to Clark that "to suggest or dictate to state legislatures how they should select their electors" was not the DOJ’s role, nor was it even remotely appropriate. However, Donoghue and Rosen’s attempts to quell Clark's conduct were unsuccessful, and Clark continued to conduct investigations into dubious claims of voter fraud. Seeing this, Donoghue confronted Clark again, asserting that his conduct constituted "nothing less than the Justice Department meddling in an election," to which Clark responded, "I think a lot of people have meddled in this election." Former President Told DOJ Officials to Lie Then-President of the United States, Donald Trump, told his Department of Justice, often called the "people’s lawyer," to say that the election was corrupt, when the same Department of Justice had advised him this was an outright lie. In testimony given by former Acting Deputy Attorney General Richard Donoghue, Mr. Donoghue recalled a December 27th meeting where Trump was growing more frantic, even for the DOJ to seize voting machines. "He responded very quickly, and said, essentially, 'That’s not what I’m asking you to do, what I’m asking you to do is just say it was corrupt and leave the rest up to me and the Republican congressmen'," Donoghue recalled Trump telling top DOJ officials in the meeting. The former President called a meeting to discuss options for overturning the legitimate election results of the 2020 election. Despite pressure from the former President inside the Oval Office, the nation’s top lawyers remained steadfast in their oath, opposing the President and threatening to step down. "He had this arsenal of allegations that he wanted to rely on," said Donoghue, "these allegations were simply not true." Giuliani and other Trump henchmen wanted the Justice Department to be led by someone not worried about a 'reputation' In his private testimony to the committee, Rudy Giuliani, the now-suspended attorney formerly serving as Trump’s personal lawyer, mentioned that he suggested finding a new Attorney General who was not worried about his reputation. He and other Trump allies attempted to aggrandize former Assistant Attorney General for the Environment and Natural Resources Division Jeffery Clark to run the Justice Department. As former Acting Deputy Attorney General Richard Donoghue and former Acting Attorney General Jeffrey Rosen testified at the fifth 1/6 Committee hearing on Thursday, the attempt to elevate Jeffery Clark by Trump's underbosses evolved into a secret meeting with Clark and the former President. This meeting broke the long-standing precedent that contact between the White House and the Justice Department be largely limited to higher-ranking senior officials, a status not held by Clark. Along with Donoghue and Rosen, Steven Engel, the former Assistant Attorney General, expressed the concerns about such a meeting, stating that the precedent Clark and Trump defied was intended to ensure investigations are "free from either the reality or any appearance of political interference." Top DOJ Officials Call Trump’s Plan a "Murder-Suicide Pact" In stunning new testimony given by top DOJ officials inside a packed committee hearing room, the once former-President’s allies, revealed the plan to overturn the election. The plan included installing an unqualified environmental lawyer, Jeffrey Clark, as the Attorney General of the United States. From there, Clark, under the direction of Trump, planned to send a drafted letter to state officials, alleging voter fraud. Donoghue said he told Clark, "You're an environmental lawyer. How about you go back to your office, and we'll call you when there's an oil spill." "I said, good f--cking — excuse me, sorry, f'ing a-hole, congratulations, you just admitted your first step or act you would take as Attorney General would be committing a felony and violating Rule 6(e)," former White House lawyer, Eric Herschmann, recalled in his taped deposition. Sitting Members of Congress Begged for a Pardon After January 6 Insurrection Republican members of Congress asked for pardons from the former President in the days and weeks following the deadly attack on the Capitol. Cassidy Hutchinson, former aide to then-White House Chief of Staff Mark Meadows, Mo Brooks (R-AL), Matt Gaetz (R-FL), Andy Biggs (R-AZ), Louie Gohmert (R-TX), and Scott Perry (R-PA) asking the former President and his staff for pardons due to their involvement in the events leading up to the attack on January 6th. Perry’s text messages to Mark Meadows were also , where he pushed for an unqualified DOJ lawyer sympathetic to the President's fraud claims to be elevated to Attorney General. Hutchinson, in video testimony shown today, focused in on Gaetz, saying the conspiracy theory-peddling member from Florida was personally asking for a pardon as early as December. Congressman Brooks acknowledged that he did ask for a pardon. The other members, except for Gaetz, who refused to comment, asking for or inquiring about a presidential pardon. "The only reason I know to ask for a pardon is because you think you’ve committed a crime," Congressman Adam Kinzinger. Giuliani: "We’ve got lots of theories. We just don’t have the evidence." Rusty Bowers, the speaker of Arizona’s House of Representatives, stated he resisted pressure from Trump and his lieutenants to Trump’s loss in the state. "I didn’t want to be used as a pawn.” He told the panel that he had refused attempts from Trump and his legal advisers who said they had evidence of fraud sufficient to reverse the election outcome yet never produced any. The committee on the fact that Mr. Trump and his lawyers knew they didn’t have evidence of widespread election fraud. Mr. Bowers testified that Trump lawyer Giuliani admitted he had not uncovered evidence of widespread fraud. Bowers recalled Giuliani saying: "We’ve got lots of theories. We just don’t have the evidence." Mr. Bowers questioned the legality of participating in such a scheme, to which he testified Mr. Eastman responded: "Just do it and let the courts work it out." The panel played a video showing Mr. Trump’s lawyers, including Mr. Giuliani, Mr. Eastman, and Cleta Mitchell, as they worked to overturn the election. Mr. Giuliani held hearings and made calls to Republican lawmakers around the country. The scheme to use fake electors is the subject of a Justice Department investigation. Compelling Testimony Given by Georgia Election Workers Wandrea "Shaye" Moss and her mother Ruby Freeman were Georgia election workers for the 2020 election. They gave testimony on Tuesday discussing how former President Trump and his lawyer Rudy Giuliani the mother daughter pair claiming they had engaged in fraudulent behavior in order to overturn the election results. Video evidence of Moss and Freeman moving a box of regular ballots and passing a mint between one another had been twisted by conspiracy theorists and Trump supporters into evidence of a suitcase containing false ballots and USB drives containing heroin or cocaine. This footage was then used by Guliani to target Moss and Freedman, labeling them as responsible for rigging the election in favor of Biden. Death Threats, Racist Insults, and More Thrown at Election Workers for Simply Doing Their Job The former President referred to Ruby Freeman as a “hustler,” claiming that she was a Freeman and her daughter were villainized by Trump supporters, received threats, and no longer felt comfortable going by their given names or being out in public. Ms. Freeman, an entrepreneur and beloved member of the community, was threatened into a reclusion because of the lies and actions of former President Trump and his allies. Shaye Moss, Freeman’s daughter, testified before the 1/6 Committee that in the wake of the hateful and racist threats and the false accusations that she gained sixty pounds, second-guesses all of her actions, and doesn’t feel safe anywhere. "It’s turned my life upside down," Moss through tears and a shaky voice. Freeman voiced a similar experience saying that she has lost her name and reputation because Giuliani decided to use her and her daughter as a scapegoat. Freeman also testified that she was unable to leave her home for the two months following the election after FBI officials warned that leaving would jeopardize her safety. "Donald Trump didn’t care about the threats of violence. He did not condemn them, he made no effort to stop them; he went forward with his fake allegations anyway," Rep. Cheney said. Moss's mother, Ms. Freeman, who also worked the polls in Georgia during the 2020 election, expressed her disbelief with the former President’s conduct following his defeat to Joe Biden: "The president of the United States is supposed to represent everyone, not to target one. But, he targeted me." Georgia Officials Detail Former President’s Pressure Campaign Georgia Secretary of State, Brad Raffensperger, outlined the call heard around the world. In the days following the election, the former President Raffensperger, begging and demanding that he find 11,000 votes from Trump. Despite the intense pressure by the former President and his team, Raffensperger resisted the demands and testified that the 2020 election in Georgia was fair and free. Because of his refusal to harvest non-existent votes, Raffensperger and his family were . Raffensperger testified: "And my wife started getting texts. And then some people broke into my daughter-in-law’s home," he said. | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE: June 24, 2022

| **Dr. Scott Jensen Releases Statement on the Overturning of Roe Vs. Wade**
(Chaska, MN) – Dr. Scott Jensen (R-Chaska) released the following statement regarding today’s Supreme Court decision to overturn Roe versus Wade:

**“We have seen many lives diminished after this court ruling decades ago. While Minnesota’s Supreme Court ruled that there is a right to an abortion, as governor I still want to seek out loving and caring alternatives like universal adoption, family planning measures to prevent pregnancies and policies like counseling and alternative referrals, medical assistance and other measures that value people - both born and unborn. I will be a leader that will solve problems, as I have done before such as bipartisan insulin legislation, which values life. Minnesota values are not 'up-to-the-moment-of-birth' abortions as Tim Walz and Peggy Flanagan support. The restrictions allowed by our courts are supported by the vast majority of Minnesotans and late term, nine month abortions championed by Tim Walz are not Minnesota values. I would ask Minnesotans to carefully reflect on that position, along with many other distinctive differences like gas prices, public safety and inflation and choose better leadership that offers positive solutions for this state."**

disclaimer_text: Paid for by United Rural Democrats](https://click
body:
Please take time today to donate to an abortion fund near you. | | | If you have not seen it already Peter, **the Supreme Court of the United States released its decision on _Dobbs v. Jackson_ and overturned _Roe v. Wade_** , which guaranteed a constitutional right to the fundamental right to choose, and _Casey v. Planned Parenthood_ , which protected abortion further by deeming an "undue burden" on abortion access unconstitutional. As folks living in rural communities, we understand the gravity of this decision. In the Midwest where reproductive health clinics are hard to come by and states have trigger laws in place, this ruling will only make it more difficult for people to access abortions. **Abortions will continue to happen** , and people in rural America with the means can fly to states on the east and west coasts, creating a higher demand for abortion care in other states as well. **But for folks living in our communities who do not have the means, this ruling is catastrophic.** Without access, marginalized rural Americans cannot have the right to choose. Friends,

The Supreme Court just struck down the constitutional right to abortion.

This is devastating news for people across the country who need access to abortions. _First and foremost, my heart goes out to you._

**Abortion access in America is in crisis.** We are losing our fundamental right to make our own health care decisions, and it’s going to impact the most vulnerable among us.

But let me be clear: Republicans have been working towards this day for a long time. They are dead-set on rolling back our reproductive rights, and they have been working for years to lay the groundwork for a nationwide abortion ban.

As a pro-choice champion, I helped pass the strongest reproductive rights law in the country so that abortion is protected in Oregon and is still legal today.

I will continue to always fight to protect abortion rights and push back against efforts to put these decisions in the hands of the government. **Planned Parenthood Action Fund endorsed my campaign because they recognize the work I have done and know I’m going to keep fighting to protect the right to abortion.**

My opponent is an extreme Republican who has campaigned on a strict anti-abortion platform. He’s promised to roll back women’s reproductive freedoms and called for overturning _Roe_.

This election is going to be a choice between a pro-choice leader and someone who wants to strip away our rights. I am going to fight like hell to make sure we win this seat, but I need your help.

## Time to VOTE
---
There are only **four days left** until the election, Tuesday, June 28! We have been knocking hundreds of doors every day and meeting people whether it’s on the streets, at protests, or at their homes.
---
#### How to Vote
Find out where to drop off your mail-in ballot or vote in-person using the secretary of state’s handy tool: [https://www.sos.state.co.us/pubs/elections/VIP.html](https://f69e.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=62b60f436adcc8556d070a7b&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.sos.state.co.us%2Fpubs%2Felections%2FVIP.html&w=6276c8dd541828029d66292f&l=en-US&s=e-fGg0RgCoxIqs_7fyzi9pWRaxo%3D)
1. **Mail-in ballots** : The deadline for mail-in ballots has passed, but you can still drop them off at your local ballot box until 7 PM on June 28. Click the link above to find your closest drop box.
2. **In-person** : Voting sites across the district have already opened. On election day, June 28, they will be open from 7 AM to 7 PM. To find your Voter Service and Polling Center, click the link above.

Peter, the Supreme Court has overturned _Roe v. Wade_. In 23 states, including Texas, abortion bans may now go into effect without federal protection. This is a dark day in our history. This hits close to home. McAllen, TX, right here in our district, is home to the last remaining abortion clinic on the Texas-Mexico border. And now, with Texas’ abortion ban trigger law going into effect, the state will likely move to close the clinic and end access to safe and legal abortion. Like many places in this country, abortions and reproductive care were already difficult to find in Texas due to the 6-week abortion ban passed last September. We’ve seen how harmful it has been, especially to the most vulnerable Texans: Black and brown women, immigrants, and low-income and young women. Those folks and all South Texans looking for reproductive care will now either have to cross the border or travel thousands upon thousands of miles to other states for an abortion. The South as a whole will become a desert for reproductive care, leaving tens of millions of people without options. **Let me make this very clear: I am a candidate who knows the value of reproductive care and will continue to fight for reproductive rights, because the people of this district and this country deserve the right to make choices about their bodies for themselves.** We can no longer count on the conservative-leaning Court to protect our rights — so we have to depend on Congress moving forward. It is urgent that we codify _Roe v. Wade_ into federal law. The House has already acted, but we must now demand the Senate act. Today, we need to be there for each other and take care of one another. Tomorrow, the fight continues. This is not over. In solidarity, Michelle Vallejo

subject: I'm not ready to let extremist politicians take away our right to choose.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Ohio Democratic Party and not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
| Team,

Like many of you, I am deeply saddened by the Supreme Court's decision to overturn _Roe v. Wade_ and effectively upend nearly 50 years of progress at the hands of far-right judges.

Despite this decision, the majority of Ohioans believe a woman has the right to reproductive freedom – including the right to safe and legal abortion.

I have always – and will always – stand up for the full range of reproductive health care. I continue to stand alongside the majority of Americans who firmly believe that the choice to have an abortion is a fundamental right, and is a decision that should be left between a woman and her doctor.

Governor Mike DeWine is proud to be fervently anti-choice. DeWine has already directed Ohio’s attorney general to institute one of the most extreme bans on abortion in the country once the Supreme Court decision is finalized.

The midterm elections this November will ultimately be make or break for reproductive rights in Ohio. While DeWine is actively working to tear down reproductive rights, as your governor, I will stand with the majority of Ohioans who believe in access to safe, legal abortion.

subject: Roe overturned: What does that mean for Pennsylvania?

body:
Dear Friend,

We got gut-wrenching news today. The Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade, the case that protected our right to abortion in the U.S.

With its cruel decision on Dobbs v. Jackson Women's Health Organization, the court gave states the right to ban abortion. For the first time EVER, it stole a right it once granted Americans. Who knows what rights we'll lose next?

We can grieve now, but not for long, because this is the time that WE MUST FIGHT for our rights — the right to control our bodies and to protect our privacy. Politicians should NOT have the power to make our medical decisions for us.

What's next? Well, 13 states have trigger laws that will ban abortion, most of them immediately. And a total of 26 states will ultimately likely eliminate abortion rights, leaving more than 36 million without access to this essential health care in their states.

What does that mean for us in Pennsylvania? Abortion is still legal in our state. For now.

But it’s been under attack by conservative lawmakers with only the governor’s veto protecting it. With Mastriano leading the Republicans for governor, we need to start planning for loss of abortion rights AND of our democracy in PA. We need to organize NOW, because not only did they take away this human right, the court also just gutted Miranda rights, expanded concealed carry, and dealt a killer blow to separation of church and state by allowing funding for religious schools. It’s time to reform our Supreme Court!

We stand in solidarity with you as we work together to protect HUMAN RIGHTS and progressive values in our state.

Laura Nevitt
Operations Manager

body:
Supreme Court Turns Back the Clock on Individual Freedom and Women’s Rights | | | team, On Friday, June 24, 2022, the United States Supreme Court in a 6 – 3 decision, overturned _Roe v. Wade_. The impact of this ruling will prove to be dangerous for the lives and health of women across this country. Today’s ruling not only turned back the hands of time on women’s rights in our country, but it also will result in disproportionate harm to those of lesser financial means. Today’s decision undermines public health -- an outcome that cannot be ignored. The response to today’s decision requires that the Senate immediately reconsider and pass the **Women's Health Protection Act****** to codify the rights established in _Roe v. Wade_ so that the reach of today’s decision is short-lived. In January 1973 the Supreme Court of the United States issued its ruling in the case of _Roe v. Wade,___ a case that originated in Texas.__ By a majority of 7 -2 supported by both conservative and liberal Justices, the Court recognized the fundamental constitutional right of women to manage their own reproductive health without government interference. Today, the Court has determined that, in fact, women do not have such a right. Their ruling takes a giant step backward from full equality for women in our country. Women in Texas have already experienced major steps backward with women’s reproductive rights. Specifically, in September of 2021, Texas women had their reproductive rights severely restricted by S.B. 8. By no longer allowing women, along with their health care providers and families, to make their most significant and deeply personal health decisions, the Court is granting state legislatures ultimate power and control over women’s futures. Any decision to terminate a pregnancy is complex, extremely difficult and one that is not to be taken lightly. Yet, I believe that the woman facing this decision is equipped to weigh all of her considerations and that she should have the right to make this determination. Now, depending on one’s state laws, women may even be forced against their own will to bring children into the world who will suffer debilitating lifelong illnesses or those who were conceived through rape or incest. Women’s reproductive rights should be respected through the right to choose. As Houston’s next mayor, I am committed to the restoration of women’s rights in this country. We must use this moment to take action. First, I urge everyone to contact their Senators and insist that they support the **reintroduction and passage of the****Women’s Health Protection Act****to ensure women’s rights to control their own reproductive health choices.** Second, make sure that you are registered to vote and that you vote for candidates in 2022 who support the restoration of women’s reproductive rights. Finally, make sure that you support organizations that support the restoration of women’s reproductive rights like Planned Parenthood – **[www.plannedparenthood.org.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/atcYNHk4Eh2YdGnwBh-YDNRt6XqsA94USbN6r7k1NAwvh15THV8sEJs7C1WCPs13P6nwlPUNz5ZWc0Odx9My4huAZda9pUd64j2Fo0ZR8DFSOesSwJJp3Tm7xC9TgKrCiJGd2k1zWwR9uLieQLfu7OX890qpLvFBHFIUgTyHFr4z5hUnJks3pIUFojhPd0WCQwuDz59S_nf7IH-eabfwGwTigF2LJBmIKEt64-1SgGls2US_xNV5o5egQ-bxmOXWRhgmKCBK9hH8eqdho6J3A9X0FRzY4gSout4e4n_SOFybkb4Ep3DTXBz171nb2rTJ/3n6/mgxElMZdS1iyfqcqycTtfA/h0/uJdBWfR1AVrDkxv760mh2PvLaQgfMfbI64cM2fOywyA) ** Thank you, Amanda K. body:
[](https://act.myngp.com/el/Q2eq2_RmoF51QTwUMDCGs_hVKgTVb2MnQ4dP87O_yl4=/nVGkJGtT9FhMfZn4CQDtTGMhabiPZWNh5mfHFBv0PcA=)
Peter,
Today's U.S. Supreme Court decision to abolish the Constitutional right to abortion is an unconscionable assault on the rights of women in this country. The right to bodily autonomy has long been recognized as a fundamental right, but the U.S. Supreme Court's radical conservative majority led by Justice Alito has twisted our Constitution and discarded decades of well set precedent.
This is a critical time for our nation. Yesterday, New York's concealed carry law was overturned. Today, it was a women's right to choose. Tomorrow, what will it be? Today's ruling is an incredible setback for our country. It is a travesty that will inflict real harm on thousands of women and families. Twenty-six states in our nation are now certain or likely to ban abortion.
**[Jon Kaiman speaks on the steps of SCOTUS](https://act.myngp.com/el/Q2eq2_RmoF51QTwUMDCGs_hVKgTVb2MnQ4dP87O_yl4=/bqhtrwEAwu46ma61N9_M7A-wGKtPXXxk4RbqH7llSUM=?v=EtEEEiRxpdY).**
In May, when the draft of this terrible decision was leaked, I immediately traveled to Washington, D.C. to protest. What I saw there inspired me - hundreds of people, young and old, standing together to defend our rights. This is how we must fight back. It is how we will reclaim our rights.
[](https://act.myngp.com/el/Q2eq2_RmoF51QTwUMDCGs_hVKgTVb2MnQ4dP87O_yl4=/bqhtrwEAwu46ma61N9_M7A-wGKtPXXxk4RbqH7llSUM=?v=EtEEEiRxpdY)
It is important now more than ever to channel our frustrations into constructive action. The Republicans in Congress are now ready to pass a national abortion ban if they win control in November. We cannot let this happen.
**We must act to protect all those who seek reproductive care.**
**We must provide resources for those who live in states where their rights are no longer guaranteed.**
**We must enact federal legislative protection for abortion rights.**
When I am in Congress, I will do just that. I am a fighter. I have been my whole life. I will fight Republican attempts to ban and criminalize abortion. I will fight to codify federal protections for abortion.
We must keep NY-03 blue in November, and we must support Democrats up and down the ballot. Our rights and freedoms depend on it.
**[Please click here to join my campaign with a contribution today](https://act.myngp.com/el/Q2eq2_RmoF51QTwUMDCGs_hVKgTVb2MnQ4dP87O_yl4=/iLf5MgxOaE1ZjScHBPwayO_svlzKk-ppjoCTuDQqeAU=?refcode=website).**
Thank you,
Jon Kaiman

Friend - I am devastated. I am a proud girl dad and today's Supreme Court decision weighs heavy on my heart. My daughter deserves better.
Like the majority of Americans, I firmly believe that a woman should control and determine her own reproductive journey and every woman has the right to full body autonomy. I stand firm in the belief that any medical decisions should be made privately between a woman and her doctor.
My foundational and unwavering belief is that women’s rights are human rights .
SHOW YOUR SUPPORT FOR WOMEN'S RIGHTS TODAY [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/shuwaskiyoung?refcode=em_dobbs06242022]
Today’s Supreme Court decision on Dobbs which also overturns Roe v. Wade is disappointing and has rolled back 50 years of settled law that a woman has the right to make decisions regarding her own body .
Because of the 2007 trigger law, this decision will almost immediately cause women in Mississippi to lose abortion access.
I understand that we exist in a political landscape and culture that ties in religious beliefs and communal values on a woman's reproductive journey. However, our country’s Constitution is predicated on the separation of church and state.
As the future Congressman of Mississippi’s Third District it is my responsibility to guarantee this inherent right to all American women. Will you support my campaign and ensure that we get a pro-women, pro-choice representative in Congress? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/shuwaskiyoung?refcode=em_dobbs06242022]
SUPPORT A PRO-WOMEN, PRO-CHOICE CANDIDATE TODAY [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/shuwaskiyoung?refcode=em_dobbs06242022]
I know that this is a scary time for millions of women throughout the country. Please know that you are seen and your voices are heard. I will continue to fight for women's rights and the rights that we all deserve.
Yours in service,
Shuwaski Young
Democratic Nominee, MS-03

clean_body: Reproductive rights are human rights. | = Today, the Supreme Court turned back the clock on women’s rights by half a century. Their decision to overturn Roe v. Wade is a dangerous attack on our most fundamental freedoms, Peter. No unelected justice, no politician in a state house or Congress, no one besides a patient, her family, and her doctor should be involved in making incredibly personal reproductive healthcare decisions. As a mother, I know that pregnancy and having children is an incredibly life-altering experience, entailing responsibility and sacrifice. It’s something that no one should be forced into. = Peter, we’ve known that this moment was coming, and it’s terrible to consider what happens next. Here in Wisconsin, a pre-Roe law banning almost all abortions could once again take effect. Meanwhile, radical right-wing politicians could feel emboldened to attack other personal rights - from marriage equality to access to contraception. Politicians are taking away our rights. We MUST prove to them that we will not go back. We have to do whatever it takes to restore abortion access across this country. subject: Statement on the Supreme Court Decision Overturning Roe vs Wade.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Gashi for Congress
body:
Dear Friends:
I am compelled to write you again in the wake of the Supreme Court decision today.
Today, the Supreme Court ruled to effectively allow states to ban abortion, overturning _Roe vs Wade _and a half century of precedent that a woman should make decisions about her own body and well-being without interference from the State. Yesterday, the Supreme Court overturned a century of precedent in New York State's ability to regulate gun ownership.
Experience and all objective evidence show that banning abortion doesn't stop abortion, it only stops safe abortion. This decision directly and meaningfully endangers a woman's health and well-being. This is why an overwhelming majority of Americans support access to legal and safe abortion.
An overwhelming majority of Americans also support common sense gun reform, but the Republican Party has successfully manipulated our laws and judicial nominating process to achieve this unjust and undemocratic, partisan court. This partisan packed Supreme Court is more concerned about promoting an extremist, conservative ideology than representing the actual will of the American people.
Many of us are horrified - we are united in our complaints - but must be united in action as well. We clearly cannot rely on our courts to represent the overwhelming will of our majority, only Congress can fix this problem now. As your next congressman, I am committed to _actually passing _legislation that would protect the health and safety of our families and to protect a woman's right to choose.

Sincerely,

body:
Peter,
I’ll be honest — no matter how much I tried to prepare myself for this, I still wasn’t ready.
The hyper-conservative Supreme Court’s decision to overturn Roe v. Wade and take away women’s right to bodily autonomy is disgusting. It’s dehumanizing. And it’s infuriating.
For centuries, women have fought tooth and nail for the rights we have today. And now, our daughters and granddaughters will have fewer rights than we did.
In times like this, it can be hard to find the will to keep fighting and keep demanding rights that should never have been in question.
But that’s the only way we’re going to fix this, Peter — to follow in the footsteps of countless generations of women, to stand together and refuse to give up until every single woman has the right to make her own choices, to protect her own health and safety, and to live the life she wants for herself.
And that fight starts right here in Florida, with what has now become the most critical gubernatorial election in decades.
Women’s rights are on the ballot this year, and Nikki Fried is the only candidate who’s never wavered in the fight for abortion rights. Will you rush a $20 donation right now to help us elect a Governor who will protect Florida women and fight for our right to choose? name: Christopher Kurka
subject: Roe is OVERTURNED!!!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kurka for Governor PO Box 871181 Wasilla AK 99687
body:
It's past time to make Alaska abortion free! Let's do it!

| Hi Peter, Today we received the joyous news that Roe vs. Wade has been overturned by the Supreme Court! This is monumental and is a historical moment in our state and nation. Below is the statement I sent out to the Press this morning. _Please note the action item of calling Governor Dunleavy to call a legislative session so we can immediately pass the Alaska Life at Conception Act to protect preborn Alaskans._ **SCOTUS OVERTURNS ROE V. WADE: KURKA CALLS ON GOVERNOR TO CALL SPECIAL SESSION** (**WASILLA, ALASKA** JUNE. 24 2022) Today the U.S. Supreme Court announced the official overturn of Roe v. Wade. According to the High-Court the issue of abortion will now be returned to the state legislatures for their determination. Well known pro-life advocate and Gubernatorial candidate, Representative Christopher Kurka, celebrated the news of the Court decision by saying “**Roe vs. Wade has been a scourge on our nation for nearly 60 years.** It was a decision that was both immoral and unconstitutional and **I am overjoyed that it has been overturned today**. While I remain steadfast in my belief that States could and should have ended abortion without it, today’s monumental decision _removes any pretense of excuses_ and paves the way toward an abortion free society.” Kurka, who is the son and grandson of pro-life advocates has spent the majority of his life in pro-life work. He is the former Executive Director and Vice President of Alaska Right to Life, is the published author of pro-life treatises, was the original drafter and sponsor of Alaska’s Personhood initiative, and has worked for many years on the Alaska Life at Conception Act. Considering the new SCOTUS ruling, Kurka is once again asking Alaskans to join him in urging Governor Dunleavy to call a special legislative session on the road system to immediately guarantee the equal protection of preborn Alaskans through passage of the [_Alaska Life at Conception Act_](https://kurkaforgovernor.nationbuilder.com/r?u=4EEqepzzvqAih9Zt-SDGfQHcVow2f9eU902uHHSZSLvo3q_sDL7ia0DwcUQHt3b1_5eL3gmJ07Xie-gt76vcVQ&e=c3e286dcf444e6546a293f48f4c73831&utm_source=kurkaforgovernor&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=roe_v_wade&n=1) _._ Further, Kurka asks Governor Dunleavy to **immediately cease the abortion payments from the State of Alaska.** “Even though we are in campaign season, _we must lay aside our differences and speak with one voice to demand a halt to the unconstitutional killing of the state’s most vulnerable and voiceless residents_. The time for excuses is past. Now is the moment of truth. I will gladly work with Governor Dunleavy and my legislative colleagues to help make Alaska abortion free. **As a society we cannot afford to wait a moment longer to end the genocide of abortion in Alaska and our unborn neighbors urgently deserve our united voice on their behalf.** ” said Kurka. ### Please call the Governor's office and ask him to call a legislative session on the road system so we can address this critical piece of legislation! His office number is 907-465-3500. Soli Deo Gloria, Christopher Kurka [www.ChrisKurka.com](https://kurkaforgovernor.nationbuilder.com/r?u=HTIUaYWGgtW-Sq8jttULzZYHrXjSSqDZFm4adezdWWY&e=c3e286dcf444e6546a293f48f4c73831&utm_source=kurkaforgovernor&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=roe_v_wade&n=2) Now that Legislative session is over, I am able to receive contributions again! Please consider helping us fund our summer campaign efforts by clicking on the link below: [](https://kurkaforgovernor.nationbuilder.com/r?u=HTIUaYWGgtW-Sq8jttULzW-zEK-3Z9mAZxjdCeR3iqLWUT4kcfhLZxsXf_4rl-GR&e=c3e286dcf444e6546a293f48f4c73831&utm_source=kurkaforgovernor&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=roe_v_wade&n=3) Paid for by Kurka for Governor PO Box 871181 Wasilla AK 99687.

name: Trudy Busch Valentine
subject: Sign Your Name to Save Abortion Access
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Trudy Busch Valentine for Senate
body:
I will work relentlessly for my constituents to be able to make their decisions with their doctors.
| | |
---
Peter,

I am a nurse and a parent who loves her state, and all my life, I’ve worked to help others. I have always believed people deserve quality, compassionate healthcare – including access to contraception and abortion care.
**But now the Supreme Court has undone the nearly 50-year-old precedent set by Roe v. Wade that guarantees people the right to choose an abortion.**
Right now, in 13 states across the country, **including Missouri** , abortion is outright banned. Millions of Americans have lost a crucial freedom that we have counted on for decades.

We need to protect the legal right to have an abortion nationwide, full stop. Abortion care should be affordable and accessible to everyone. This especially includes low-income people and people of color, who will be disproportionately impacted by this.
To those reeling from this news, I'm here to say: _I'm with you._ As a healthcare worker, I believe everyone deserves access to the very best medical care. As a concerned citizen, I marched alongside my neighbors. **And as your next senator, I will work relentlessly for my constituents to be able to make their decisions with their doctors.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46934167/352383594/536008262?email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100&code=jtk68-su-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NzQzODVlYS1mOGYzLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_Xsr30rI8scEFojNT_PlmpT7ejEXbdHnAYGKcKx3nYs=&emci=fb42bedb-3deb-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=974385ea-f8f3-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=4450063)

clean_body: I will work relentlessly for my constituents to be able to make their decisions with their doctors. | | | Peter, I am a nurse and a parent who loves her state, and all my life, I’ve worked to help others. I have always believed people deserve quality, compassionate healthcare – including access to contraception and abortion care. But now the Supreme Court has undone the nearly 50-year-old precedent set by Roe v. Wade that guarantees people the right to choose an abortion. Right now, in 13 states across the country, including Missouri , abortion is outright banned. Millions of Americans have lost a crucial freedom that we have counted on for decades. We need to protect the legal right to have an abortion nationwide, full stop. Abortion care should be affordable and accessible to everyone. This especially includes low-income people and people of color, who will be disproportionately impacted by this. To those reeling from this news, I'm here to say: I'm with you. As a healthcare worker, I believe everyone deserves access to the very best medical care. As a concerned citizen, I marched alongside my neighbors. _-CNN_
Team,

For weeks now, we've known that the Supreme Court was poised to overturn _Roe v. Wade_ , but seeing the decision in print is still devastating and infuriating. We know that by issuing this ruling on the _Dobbs v. Jackson_ case, SCOTUS has effectively turned back the clock on reproductive rights and put millions of lives in danger.

For decades, extremist conservatives have been mounting an insidious campaign to control the bodies of people who can get pregnant and return our country to the time of back-alley abortions and forced pregnancies. Donald Trump and the Treason Caucus have created the reality we are living today and it is because of them that reproductive rights are no longer protected on a federal level.

But the fight does not end here, team. This situation has shown us that voting and electing the right leaders for our country is crucial for our democracy. Now is the moment to take our righteous fury and convert it into collective action. To elect and call on leaders who will protect and defend our rights, not corrupt politicians who promote cruel and anti-science agendas.

subject: The Supreme Court just overturned Roe v. Wade.
