| Ally Isom is pro-life. [Watch her response to the overturn of Roe v. Wade at the Utah GOP Debate on YouTube here.](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=00127ZoCxYMpkDhCZrC4atpZXyhKHUu_nYSHMJnaCfSefzq8JaBp7DnZZRaaFhGmDbc4JGxSi8J4_Unt2BI6jztquVUvCPsQknqF1WwQHId3D1hh5uE6-fHfrnBjRyusqE1Hxq53QfQOXQoHxrOWqRvaQ==&c=X1OgROIxBJDToF-RU_NORT-RL9lOf1-GQfXQxAB82vRXwgR598IFww==&ch=xuhmRbK0meHdgKojkvG1AlFXR_KZDIp9nifDabtfed1w13FdTdWfEA==)
---
| "Today marks a victory for life and the beginning of a renewed national dialog about reproductive health and support for women. Before we draw battle lines, let's strive to understand all voices and experiences.
"There is nothing more sacred than life. As the mother of four and grandma to five, I am pro-life. I am also pro-consent, pro-family planning, pro-responsibility and pro-compassion. This is a complex subject for every woman, which is exactly why we need more women in the United States Senate.
"At minimum, we should do more to prevent unwanted pregnancy in the first place and the law should allow the termination of a pregnancy when a mother's health is endangered, or when a woman or child is sexually assaulted. Every pregnancy is a unique experience for that woman. We must do more to support women and children, while ensuring fathers are also involved and responsible for their children."
-U.S. Senate Candidate Ally Isom

This is devastating, everyone.
**The Supreme Court just overturned _Roe v. Wade_ , opening the door for Mitch McConnell to achieve his ultimate goal: banning abortion nationwide.**
I know that for so many, this news is scary and traumatic, and it feels like there's nothing that can be done. But we must stay engaged, because the work we’re doing has never been more important than it is now.

Friend,

I'm writing today to personally ask you to be one of the 2,500 Election Year Founding Donors we need to defeat GOP extremism this year and flip Arizona's governorship blue. **But first, let me explain why I'm running – and why I need your urgent support to win. **
My story is the story of Arizona: I'm a proud child of immigrants, and my parents instilled in me a belief that, if you work hard, anything is possible. I grew up knowing that to be the promise of Arizona – and it's what I'm running to restore.

Throughout my life, I've been blessed to be able to live out that promise, but too few people can say the same. I became mayor of my hometown of Nogales, served in the Obama administration and started a small business to create jobs in the state I love. But thanks to the failed leadership of Republicans like Doug Ducey, thousands of Arizonans have watched our health care and education systems suffer, our democracy face constant threats and our future get darker.
**I'm running for governor to restore the promise of Arizona – to restore the bright future we and our families deserve. Right now we're officially in the election year, so I can't afford a single misstep. That means I need you with me, friend, from the very beginning. So I'm asking personally:**

Becoming an Election Year Founding Donor of our campaign is about more than a donation – it's about joining our movement to transform our broken education system, defend the right to vote and build a state that works for _all_ people.
And here's the thing: It's not just the movement we need – it's a movement we can _win_. We CAN flip Arizona blue, elect our first Latino governor in almost 50 years and make so much progress for all our people – but I'm going to need everyone on this grassroots team with me to make it happen. **So please, I'm counting on your support: [Rush $5 or more now – before our critical midnight deadline – to become an Election Year Founding Donor of our campaign to defeat GOP extremism and flip Arizona blue!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46934193/352383708/1742512187?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk855-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTQ2MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OTQzODVlYS1mOGYzLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wQYp-FUNgY-ft4fCFVSR3hXurv7ah_q-yDsPjwaWBJM=)**

Standing Proudly with Houston’s LGBTQ+ Community | | | Hi team, As an ally of the LGBTQ+ community, I stand up against discrimination of the LGBTQ+ community and stand for the empowerment of the LGBTQ+ community. As PRIDE month wraps up, I am excited to join my fellow Houstonians for the 44th annual Houston PRIDE Parade and festival this weekend. The PRIDE movement officially traces its roots to the incidents of June 28, 1969, at the Stonewall Inn in New York City. On that date members of the LGBTQ+ community stood up and fought back against discrimination and police brutality in what is now recognized as the birth of the LGBTQ+ rights movement. PRIDE speaks so strongly about how Houston is widely recognized as one of the most diverse cities in American and the world. PRIDE is uniquely significant in that the LGBTQ+ community is itself ultimately diverse encompassing individuals of every identity, race, faith, ability, ethnicity, class, belief and so much more. PRIDE is a powerful reminder that as an entire community we are stronger, more successful, more innovative, and more human because of our diversity and inclusion. I fully recognize that we still have much work to do, and as your next Mayor of Houston, I recognize that our commitment to the LGBTQ+ community must go beyond PRIDE month; we must champion equality and access to justice for the LGBTQ+ community year-round in Houston. Please join me in celebrating PRIDE this month and continuing Houston’s commitment to being a city that respects every human being. I also hope to see you at the Houston LGBTQ+ Political Caucus “Pillars of Pride” event that I am presenting on July 9!

clean_body: Standing Proudly with Houston’s LGBTQ+ Community | | | Hi team, As an ally of the LGBTQ+ community, I stand up against discrimination of the LGBTQ+ community and stand for the empowerment of the LGBTQ+ community. As PRIDE month wraps up, I am excited to join my fellow Houstonians for the 44th annual Houston PRIDE Parade and festival this weekend. The PRIDE movement officially traces its roots to the incidents of June 28, 1969, at the Stonewall Inn in New York City. On that date members of the LGBTQ+ community stood up and fought back against discrimination and police brutality in what is now recognized as the birth of the LGBTQ+ rights movement. PRIDE speaks so strongly about how Houston is widely recognized as one of the most diverse cities in American and the world. PRIDE is uniquely significant in that the LGBTQ+ community is itself ultimately diverse encompassing individuals of every identity, race, faith, ability, ethnicity, class, belief and so much more. PRIDE is a powerful reminder that as an entire community we are stronger, more successful, more innovative, and more human because of our diversity and inclusion. I fully recognize that we still have much work to do, and as your next Mayor of Houston, I recognize that our commitment to the LGBTQ+ community must go beyond PRIDE month; we must champion equality and access to justice for the LGBTQ+ community year-round in Houston. Please join me in celebrating PRIDE this month and continuing Houston’s commitment to being a city that respects every human being. I also hope to see you at the Houston LGBTQ+ Political Caucus “Pillars of Pride” event that I am presenting on July 9! As your next mayor, I will proudly represent and work to move ALL Houstonians forward. Thank you, Amanda K. Edwards Amanda K. Edwards has the experience and innovative vision to move Houston forward. subject: Today’s decision is a disaster. And just the beginning.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ben Smilowitz for Congress
body:
| | | |
---
|
---
| | | **Dear Peter,**

Shame on the U.S. Supreme Court. Shame on these extremist judges and politicians, and anyone who supported them with a vote or a financial contribution.

The decision today to overturn Roe v. Wade is a devastating setback for our country, and for the rights of women everywhere.

More than ever, we need leaders willing to stand up for equal rights and the rights of women. Because, let’s be clear, this assault on _our_ rights will absolutely not end here.

Justice Clarence Thomas said as much in his concurring opinion overturning Roe v. Wade. **Justice Thomas believes we should also overturn cases granting rights to same-sex marriage and contraception.**

[Yes, he actually said that.](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=10e109ff4a&e=0faa9de128)

We need leaders willing to fight the extremists forcing our country to the far-right.

We need leaders that are serious about protecting women’s rights. Serious about protecting equality. Serious about voting rights.

Leaders that are serious about this country and our collective future.

Talk is cheap. We don’t need politicians that say they believe one thing and then fund the other side.

My opponent David Trone donated to and helped elect some of the most ardent anti-abortion, anti-voting rights Republicans, including $46,941 to Texas Governor Greg Abbott and $11,000 to Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton.

**Yes, Rep. David Trone has been a major financial backer of the very leaders of the movement that brought us today’s ruling. **

Rep. Trone says, “I sign my checks to buy access.” [Yes, he sure does. $150,000 in total to Republicans around the country. ](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=659c7c89b0&e=0faa9de128)

Well, Trone’s brand of pay-to-play politics has consequences. Empowering hateful, extremist leaders to advance one's business and line one's pockets, askewing one's own supposed political ideology, is a broken politics that is plaguing our nation.

It’s a broken politics that has led us to today’s decision, and a Supreme Court that is far, far right of the rest of America. Yes, right of even most Republicans.

We can do better. We must do better. [Please, support my campaign and every campaign that stands up for equal rights and believes we must go forward, not backwards. ](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=1e5efea29b&e=0faa9de128)

We must fight back. And we need leaders that _know_ what side they’re on.

Sincerely,

Ben

More than ever, we need leaders willing to stand up for equal rights and the rights of women. Because, let’s be clear, this assault on our rights will absolutely not end here. Justice Clarence Thomas said as much in his concurring opinion overturning Roe v. Wade. Justice Thomas believes we should also overturn cases granting rights to same-sex marriage and contraception. We need leaders willing to fight the extremists forcing our country to the far-right. We need leaders that are serious about protecting women’s rights. Serious about protecting equality. Serious about voting rights. Leaders that are serious about this country and our collective future. Talk is cheap. We don’t need politicians that say they believe one thing and then fund the other side. My opponent David Trone donated to and helped elect some of the most ardent anti-abortion, anti-voting rights Republicans, including $46,941 to Texas Governor Greg Abbott and $11,000 to Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton. Yes, Rep. David Trone has been a major financial backer of the very leaders of the movement that brought us today’s ruling. Rep. Trone says, “I sign my checks to buy access.” Well, Trone’s brand of pay-to-play politics has consequences. Empowering hateful, extremist leaders to advance one's business and line one's pockets, askewing one's own supposed political ideology, is a broken politics that is plaguing our nation. It’s a broken politics that has led us to today’s decision, and a Supreme Court that is far, far right of the rest of America. Yes, right of even most Republicans. We can do better. We must do better. We must fight back. And we need leaders that know what side they’re on. clean_body: | | | Friends,Today is a tragic day in American history, but I must impart on you one thing above all else – we cannot lose hope. The powers that be want us disempowered, disconnected and disengaged. But we will not let them break our spirits or push us to despair.We are more determined than ever. Solidarity is crucial now. The criminalization of abortion is highly disturbing to me. This tragic decision to overturn Roe and its 50 year precedent will not stop abortions, it will stop safe abortions. It will push women to the brink and endanger their lives.The radical right-wing court has condemned a new generation of women, but this fight is far from over. By taking the decision away from women and putting the very personal decision of motherhood in the hands of state governments, we are creating an even more unequal playing field for women. We are robbing women of their agency, their self-determination, and their freedom to be in control of their own choices and lives. daughters have less freedom than our mothers did, and we cannot allow anti-freedom fundamentalist Republicans to win. This is only the beginning, they will now turn their attention to making abortion illegal federally and we cannot sit back and let women die.Overturning Roe v. Wade disproportionately affects working class women and women of color by stifling their opportunities for liberating participation in the economy and workforce. The fight for reproductive justice is the fight for women's autonomy. Every woman has the right to choose if she wants to be a mother or not. The working class progressive movement is more crucial than ever.This is an act of violence against every person with a uterus in this country, and solidarity and resilience are our only options. clean_body: I need you to stand with me against these heinous attacks. | Peter, I'll just say it: MSNBC has a racism problem in their ranks. Back in April, they ran an article by a man who had these fine things to say about me: | "Herschel Walker's candidacy is a white insult to Black people." "I make a hard distinction between black conservatives and these tokens (HERSCHEL WALKER AND TIM SCOTT), who are out here right now, shucking and jiving for their white handlers." This week they're coming after me again, and this time one of their writers is accusing me of being... anti-Black. Yep, you read that right. The author writes, "GOP Senate candidate Herschel Walker's entire political career is rooted in anti-Blackness." This is so absurd, it's hard to know where to begin. I will always speak my mind, stand up for myself, and stand up for the people I love - no matter what color their skin is. Far-Left political pundits keep attacking me because I'm a Black conservative. I don't fit into their worldview of how a Black person is supposed to think and act. It's time we sent them a message. You can help prove them wrong - and blow their minds - by helping this Black conservative get elected to the United States Senate. I'd like to show our critics exactly how much grassroots support my campaign has. NEWSFLASH: I was born Black, and I've never been anything else. ADDITIONAL NEWSFLASH: Nobody tells me what to do or how to think. I look at the issues and make up my own mind based on my faith, core values, and life experiences. I want to win this race and get America back on the right track. I want to unite Americans - not divide them by race or class. name: Gabby Giffords
subject: Congress has finally found the courage to act

body:
After nearly 30 years of inaction, both the House and the Senate have passed the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act.
#

Friends -
After nearly 30 years of inaction, Congress has finally found the courage to act. As of today, both the House and the Senate have passed the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act, and now it heads to the President’s desk to be signed into law.
Naysayers said it would never happen. For decades, the gun lobby has fought tooth and nail to prevent this very moment.
But the gun safety movement and our champions in Congress have worked tirelessly to pass a bipartisan gun violence prevention package. It is such an important first step forward because it will save lives.
It is an incredible achievement and one that we should all be proud of.
But we can’t stop here. As you know, yesterday the Supreme Court issued a decision in _New York State Rifle & Pistol Association Inc. v. Bruen_, an extreme ruling that imposes the gun lobby’s dangerous “guns everywhere” agenda on all of us.
So even as we celebrate the passage of the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act, the entire team at Giffords is going to continue to fight for additional reforms needed to save lives.

#
> _Maine has a codified right to abortion in the state. For my opponent to immediately join the “furious protestors” only helps to sow division and add to what may likely descend into a climate of violence.
>
> What the nation needs most now is to move forward in the spirit of compassion, trust and support – Support for women grappling with this life-changing decision, compassion toward our fellow citizens, and trust in this unique form of government as designed by our Founders. _
> * * *
>
> _**ED THELANDER STATEMENT ON SCOTUS DECISION RE: DOBBS v. JACKSON WOMEN’S HEALTH ORGANIZATION**_
> "During its long history, the United States Supreme Court has overturned prior rulings at an average rate of approximately once per year. A few instances are high-profile cases, while most are more obscure rulings. All are considered in the strict context of their constitutionality.
>
> I respect the sanctity of life, just as I will respect the rights and opinions of all the people of Maine’s First Congressional District. Regardless of one’s position on whether there is a right to life or a right to abortion, this ruling merely corrects a prior decision that was, in the view of many, flawed legal reasoning.
>
> With this decision, the Supreme Court puts the regulation of abortion back in the hands of State Legislatures, as the Founders intended. What the nation needs most now is to move forward in the spirit of compassion, trust and support – Support for women grappling with this life-changing decision, compassion toward our fellow citizens, and trust in this unique form of government as designed by our Founders."
>
> – _Ed Thelander is the Republican candidate for Maine’s 1 st Congressional District and resides in Bristol_

ED THELANDER STATEMENT ON SCOTUS DECISION RE: DOBBS v. JACKSON WOMEN’S HEALTH ORGANIZATION "During its long history, the United States Supreme Court has overturned prior rulings at an average rate of approximately once per year. A few instances are high-profile cases, while most are more obscure rulings. All are considered in the strict context of their constitutionality. I respect the sanctity of life, just as I will respect the rights and opinions of all the people of Maine’s First Congressional District. Regardless of one’s position on whether there is a right to life or a right to abortion, this ruling merely corrects a prior decision that was, in the view of many, flawed legal reasoning. With this decision, the Supreme Court puts the regulation of abortion back in the hands of State Legislatures, as the Founders intended. What the nation needs most now is to move forward in the spirit of compassion, trust and support – Support for women grappling with this life-changing decision, compassion toward our fellow citizens, and trust in this unique form of government as designed by our Founders." – Ed Thelander is the Republican candidate for Maine’s 1 st Congressional District and resides in Bristol | "CLICK TO DONATE" | | Ed Thelander is a United States Navy veteran. | | Peter,
That didn’t take long. Governor Lujan Grisham sent out a fundraising email less than an hour after the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade, bragging about how she legalized abortion up to birth in New Mexico in 2019 and asking for more donations. She attacked me for being pro-life and is doing her very best to scare New Mexicans into supporting her campaign. | | | Team, it’s Kati from the DSCC.

The Supreme Court just overturned _Roe v Wade_. While we knew this day was more than likely coming, it doesn’t make me any less appalled, devastated and to be frank -- absolutely enraged. And in fact, now that this is _real_ , I feel all of these things now more than ever. But I know I am not alone.

So we cannot stay silent, especially in this moment when this cuts so deep for so many and we’re just plain tired. We must continue to go to the mat to uphold a woman’s right to make her own health care decisions, because we know damn well extremist Republicans are not going to stop here.

body:
I thank God that Roe v Wade and Planned Parenthood v Casey were overturned this morning. I am one of those fighters who stands for LIFE, and I will NEVER back down from that position.
****
| | | **[](https://libersend.lauraloomerforcongress.com/l/jaHkxHkvgw3mMH3vyc0Hsw/QLkHetWx1zHHx3tlFvCwuA/JRBsVW763ZBFyeRwNll5akAA)**
Patriot,

[](https://libersend.lauraloomerforcongress.com/l/jaHkxHkvgw3mMH3vyc0Hsw/QLkHetWx1zHHx3tlFvCwuA/JRBsVW763ZBFyeRwNll5akAA) I thank God that Roe v Wade and Planned Parenthood v Casey were overturned this morning.

Those decisions were disastrous for America and led to the slaughter of over 60 million American babies.

America is one of only four countries in the world that have allowed for barbaric late-term abortion laws, and the company we've kept over these last few decades is embarrassing. The other three countries are Canada, North Korea and China.

That says enough.

While six bold justices overturned Roe, our fight is just beginning, and we have to fill the ranks of Congress and our state legislatures with men and women who value life and are strong enough to stand up to the unhinged Left as they go on the attack.

I am one of those fighters who stands for LIFE, and I will NEVER back down from that position.

[Help me get to Congress today.](https://libersend.lauraloomerforcongress.com/l/jaHkxHkvgw3mMH3vyc0Hsw/QLkHetWx1zHHx3tlFvCwuA/JRBsVW763ZBFyeRwNll5akAA)

As a woman, my "reproductive rights" are not infringed by this decision as the Left wants us to believe. It's pretty damn simple . . . **if a woman doesn 't want a child, don't engage in activities that will get you pregnant!**

The feminists on the Left are filled with hate and rage, but there's a reason for that. There's a saying that when a person does not have the courage to face their shame, that shame turns to anger.

Advocating for the murder of children is shameful. **And the Left will never face their shame.**

The Left dehumanizes children by promoting abortion on demand, while at the same time having the audacity to advocate for unconstitutional gun control laws, by invoking the names and faces of children killed in school shootings.

Make no mistake . . . the LEFT loves dead kids and loves killing children, because without dead kids, the Democrat Party knows that law-abiding Americans would never buy into their radical, unconstitutional, and pro-death legislation which includes stripping Americans of their Second Amendment rights, and legalizing late-term abortion.

**The Democrat Party pretends that late-term abortions don 't occur, and they lie and say that children in the womb cannot feel pain as their bodies are ripped apart, limb-by-limb.**

It's disgraceful and shameful.

But, if you get me to Congress, I will make the Leftists face their shame! [Help me do that today by donating before MIDNIGHT TONIGHT to have your donation TRIPLE MATCHED.](https://libersend.lauraloomerforcongress.com/l/jaHkxHkvgw3mMH3vyc0Hsw/QLkHetWx1zHHx3tlFvCwuA/JRBsVW763ZBFyeRwNll5akAA)

Our fight is JUST beginning, and the Democrat Party will use this decision to try and sway the upcoming Midterm Elections in their favor.

**It won 't work as long as we stand our ground and send fighters to Washington.**

With just six days left until the end of the fundraising quarter, [please donate as much as you can today to help me FIGHT for you, your family, America, and the unborn.](https://libersend.lauraloomerforcongress.com/l/jaHkxHkvgw3mMH3vyc0Hsw/QLkHetWx1zHHx3tlFvCwuA/JRBsVW763ZBFyeRwNll5akAA)

Thanks again for all that you do.

Respectfully,

The Supreme Court just decided to overturn Roe v. Wade.
| [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/15621?t=6&akid=3437%2E878179%2EICywVl) Look -

The Supreme Court just ruled to overturn _Roe v. Wade._

It is the terrifying and dangerous moment that so many of us have warned was coming, and once again, Washington is failing to protect our rights. Too many Senators lack the courage to fight for our rights. So our only option, if we are going to codify the right to reproductive freedom for every woman in this country, is to mobilize in the most competitive races where we expand our Senate majority.

North Carolina is one of our best chances to do that, and I promise that if you help me flip this seat, I will not hesitate to be the 51st vote to end the filibuster and codify abortion rights into law. [**If you want to see real change and progress in the U.S. Senate, please split a donation today to my campaign and Voter Protection Project to help us flip North Carolina and expand our majority. A 50/50 Senate is not working for our families, so it 's our job to change it.**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/15621?t=7&akid=3437%2E878179%2EICywVl) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Cheri Beasley and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $5 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/15622?t=8&akid=3437%2E878179%2EICywVl)

As former Chief Justice of the North Carolina Supreme Court, I want to be 100% clear: Reproductive freedom is a constitutional right.

This decision is exactly what extreme right-wing politicians like my opponent Ted Budd fought for. Next on their list is a full federal ban on abortion. Ted Budd wants a total ban on abortion without exceptions. And it will not stop there. This decision also lays the groundwork for attacks on LGBTQ+ rights from the Supreme Court.

I know this is a devastating moment. I share your anger, fear, and frustration, but I know that we cannot give in to defeat. We cannot back down. With our rights at stake, we must elect Senators who will expand our majority and protect our rights - and that is exactly the opportunity we have in North Carolina.
[**Please consider splitting a donation today between my campaign and Voter Protection Project and help us flip North Carolina. With your help, we will win this race, end the filibuster, and secure our rights -- from abortion to voting rights to LGBTQ equality and beyond.**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/15621?t=13&akid=3437%2E878179%2EICywVl)
Reproductive freedom is a constitutional right. It is health care. It is economic freedom. It is justice.

Thank you for standing with us in the fight.

\- Cheri Beasley

#### Announcement
**>From the Desk of Haneefah Khaaliq** Dear Hoosiers, gone...just like that! We knew it was coming and now it's here. Indiana's legislators are already preparing themselves to follow suit. 6 conservative justices...3 confirmed by our state's 2 conservative senators. 2 senators voted for by a combined 2.5M Hoosiers. Now, do you understand why both senators need replacement? Now, do you see why it can't be politics as usual? We must fight like never before!

150 years. That's how far we've gone back in time today. Look, it's clear. The Supreme Court is broken. Expressly denying rights to privacy that had already been recognized for decades? Excuse me? 13 states. That's how many banned abortion immediately right after the ruling, putting millions of women's health and lives at risk. Now, pregnant persons will have to travel miles away to get care where abortion is legal or gain access to contraceptives which could also be at risk.

The conversation can't end here! You and I both know that Roe was correct, so what now? The answer is simple. Make your voices heard like never before. Congress must pass federal legislation which means we must support congressional candidates that we know support reproductive rights. There's no place to do that better than in the voting booth! This November, make your plan to elect candidates who support women's right to choose!
**Now, here's what I need you to do right now: **
* Forward this message to nine (9) of your friends and family. Choose three (3) of them to personally call and inform them that I meant what I said at the beginning of my campaign when I said I would run for the Senate until _**_we_**_ all win!
* Commit to my campaign now by [donating $9](https://haneefahkhaaliq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b985b4d189b8b7b204cdd6958&id=91554fda55&e=a49cb82bb3) or more to keep this true grassroots campaign going.

Sincerely,

| \-- Today we find ourselves at a point in history we hoped we would never see. The U.S. Supreme Court has issued a ruling overturning the reproductive health protections put in place by Roe v. Wade. For the last half-century, Americans have had the right to make their own reproductive health choices under the care and guidance of a trusted medical provider. Now they are forced to give birth despite what their circumstances may be. In Arkansas, as well as other GOP-led states across our nation, abortions have already been banned without exception for incest or rape. Senator John Boozman praises the Court's ruling, stating that “the American people will now have the opportunity to enact their will on this issue,” We know the reality is the exact opposite. Americans were not given more rights today. Americans' rights were taken. The Dobbs v. Jackson Women's Health Organization ruling strips women of the dignity to make their own reproductive health choices and causes further trauma and harm to impregnated children and victims of incest or rape. Forced birth is not a cornerstone of a democratic society. It is now up to Congress to correct the Court's outrageous overturning of Roe by enacting legislation that will provide federal reproductive health protection for all Americans. But without a super-majority in the Senate, it is highly unlikely we will be able to do so. Your vote this November just became more important than ever. Democrats must expand their majority in the Senate to ensure legislation is passed that will restore privacy and protection to individuals making reproductive health decisions. We must replace John Boozman and his GOP colleagues who are up for reelection this November with Democrats who will restore reproductive freedom. I understand the importance of medical privacy and the right to safe, individualized reproductive healthcare. Once elected, I will work hard to pass legislation that restores an individual's right to make their own reproductive healthcare decisions.

clean_body: Your vote this November just became more important than ever. | | | | | == | \-- Today we find ourselves at a point in history we hoped we would never see. The U.S. Supreme Court has issued a ruling overturning the reproductive health protections put in place by Roe v. Wade. For the last half-century, Americans have had the right to make their own reproductive health choices under the care and guidance of a trusted medical provider. Now they are forced to give birth despite what their circumstances may be. In Arkansas, as well as other GOP-led states across our nation, abortions have already been banned without exception for incest or rape. Senator John Boozman praises the Court's ruling, stating that “the American people will now have the opportunity to enact their will on this issue,” We know the reality is the exact opposite. Americans were not given more rights today. Americans' rights were taken. The Dobbs v. Jackson Women's Health Organization ruling strips women of the dignity to make their own reproductive health choices and causes further trauma and harm to impregnated children and victims of incest or rape. Forced birth is not a cornerstone of a democratic society. It is now up to Congress to correct the Court's outrageous overturning of Roe by enacting legislation that will provide federal reproductive health protection for all Americans. But without a super-majority in the Senate, it is highly unlikely we will be able to do so. Your vote this November just became more important than ever. Democrats must expand their majority in the Senate to ensure legislation is passed that will restore privacy and protection to individuals making reproductive health decisions. We must replace John Boozman and his GOP colleagues who are up for reelection this November with Democrats who will restore reproductive freedom. I understand the importance of medical privacy and the right to safe, individualized reproductive healthcare. Once elected, I will work hard to pass legislation that restores an individual's right to make their own reproductive healthcare decisions. | | | | | | = | By donating monthly, you're investing directly in our efforts to = and helping Democrats win elections in 2022 and beyond so we can end the partisan gridlock in Washington that's stopped bills from becoming law and kept us from moving our nation forward!
